objects.definition: typedef int32_t SkUnichar;
objects.description: Typedef for a 32-bit signed integer representing a Unicode code point. Used throughout Skia for character values. No special construction or destruction required.

objects.definition: typedef uint16_t SkGlyphID;
objects.description: Typedef for a 16-bit unsigned integer representing a font glyph index. Maps to glyphs in a typeface; not a Unicode code point. Trivially copyable; no special lifecycle considerations.

objects.definition: typedef uint8_t SkAlpha;
objects.description: Alias for an 8-bit alpha component value. Range is 0 (transparent) to 255 (opaque).

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t SkColor;
objects.description: Unpremultiplied 32-bit ARGB color value in fixed, known channel order. Used broadly to specify colors in the API. Constants and helpers in this header operate on this type.

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t SkPMColor;
objects.description: Premultiplied 32-bit ARGB color value. Byte order is configuration dependent to match kBGRA_8888_SkColorType storage. Not the same ordering as SkColor.
Strongly typed enumeration describing individual color channels (R, G, B, A).
Bitmask flags describing the presence of color channels (R, G, B, A, Gray) in a format. Combines individual bits into convenience masks like RGB and RGBA.

Enumeration describing how to interpret the alpha channel of pixels: unknown, opaque, premultiplied, or unpremultiplied. The underlying type is int. Useful for selecting blending behavior and validating alpha handling in pixel formats. Details beyond the listed values are as documented in the header; no ownership or lifecycle concerns apply to enums.

objects.definition:
enum class SkBlendMode {
    kClear,         //!< r = 0
    kSrc,           //!< r = s
    kDst,           //!< r = d
    kSrcOver,       //!< r = s + (1-sa)*d
    kDstOver,       //!< r = d + (1-da)*s
    kSrcIn,         //!< r = s * da
    kDstIn,         //!< r = d * sa
    kSrcOut,        //!< r = s * (1-da)
    kDstOut,        //!< r = d * (1-sa)
    kSrcATop,       //!< r = s*da + d*(1-sa)
    kDstATop,       //!< r = d*sa + s*(1-da)
    kXor,           //!< r = s*(1-da) + d*(1-sa)
    kPlus,          //!< r = min(s + d, 1)
    kModulate,      //!< r = s*d
    kScreen,        //!< r = s + d - s*d

    kOverlay,       //!< multiply or screen, depending on destination
    kDarken,        //!< rc = s + d - max(s*da, d*sa), ra = kSrcOver
    kLighten,       //!< rc = s + d - min(s*da, d*sa), ra = kSrcOver
    kColorDodge,    //!< brighten destination to reflect source
    kColorBurn,     //!< darken destination to reflect source
    kHardLight,     //!< multiply or screen, depending on source
    kSoftLight,     //!< lighten or darken, depending on source
    kDifference,    //!< rc = s + d - 2*(min(s*da, d*sa)), ra = kSrcOver
    kExclusion,     //!< rc = s + d - two(s*d), ra = kSrcOver
    kMultiply,      //!< r = s*(1-da) + d*(1-sa) + s*d

    kHue,           //!< hue of source with saturation and luminosity of destination
    kSaturation,    //!< saturation of source with hue and luminosity of destination
    kColor,         //!< hue and saturation of source with luminosity of destination
    kLuminosity,    //!< luminosity of source with hue and saturation of destination

    kLastCoeffMode     = kScreen,     //!< last porter duff blend mode
    kLastSeparableMode = kMultiply,   //!< last blend mode operating separately on components
    kLastMode          = kLuminosity, //!< last valid value
};
objects.description: Strongly-typed enum listing all Skia blend modes. Values define how a source color is composited over a destination color. Includes standard Porter-Duff and advanced blend modes. The trailing symbolic values mark ranges and the last valid enumerant.

objects.definition: static constexpr int kSkBlendModeCount = static_cast<int>(SkBlendMode::kLastMode) + 1;
objects.description: Header-level constexpr giving the count of valid SkBlendMode values (last enum value index + 1). Although not a type, it aliases an int constant; included here only as an alias note. No pointer-constructible type is defined for it.

objects.definition:
enum class SkBlendModeCoeff {
    kZero, /** 0 */
    kOne,  /** 1 */
    kSC,   /** src color */
    kISC,  /** inverse src color (i.e. 1 - sc) */
    kDC,   /** dst color */
    kIDC,  /** inverse dst color (i.e. 1 - dc) */
    kSA,   /** src alpha */
    kISA,  /** inverse src alpha (i.e. 1 - sa) */
    kDA,   /** dst alpha */
    kIDA,  /** inverse dst alpha (i.e. 1 - da) */

    kCoeffCount
};
objects.description: Strongly-typed enum for coefficient identifiers used to express Porter-Duff blend equations. These correspond to constants or functions of source/destination colors or alphas.

Enumeration of Skia pixel color storage formats. Values describe channel order, bit depth, normalization, and special cases (e.g., XR ranges). Includes convenience aliases for native 32-bit format via kN32_SkColorType and a count constant kSkColorTypeCnt. Use to specify/interpret pixel buffers and surfaces. Construction is by value; lifetime is trivial.

objects.definition: typedef float SkScalar;
objects.description: Scalar type used throughout the API, defined as a 32-bit float. Represents general-purpose real numbers for geometry and math utilities. Construction and usage are identical to float; all accompanying macros and inline helpers operate on this type. No special ownership or destruction requirements beyond plain POD semantics.

No custom types are defined in this header. It only includes another header (include/private/base/SkPoint_impl.h) and exports it. SkPoint is referenced implicitly via the include, but it is not defined here, so it is out of scope per the instructions.

Integral width/height pair representing a 2D size in integer pixels. Provides factories (Make/MakeEmpty), setters, queries (isZero/isEmpty), accessors, area computation, equality helpers, and comparison operators. Used where integer dimensions are required.

Scalar (floating-point) width/height pair representing a 2D size. Offers factories (from scalars, from SkISize, empty), setters, zero/empty checks, accessors, equality helpers, conversion to integer sizes via round/ceil/floor, and comparison operators. SkScalar is defined elsewhere.

Axis-aligned integer rectangle using 32-bit coordinates. Provides constructors (Make*), queries, containment/intersection tests, offset/inset/outset adjustments, sorting, and rounding-friendly helpers. Empty if right <= left or bottom <= top. Operations use saturating arithmetic helpers to reduce overflow risk.

Axis-aligned floating-point rectangle. Offers multiple constructors, geometry queries, finite checks, operations (offset/inset/outset/sort), containment/intersection, conversion and rounding to SkIRect, and utilities to generate quads and debug output. Empty if not (left < right and top < bottom).

A dense, axis-aligned rounded-rectangle value type. It stores a bounding SkRect and up to four corner radii pairs (SkVector) ordered UL, UR, LR, LL. It categorizes its geometry via Type (empty, rect, oval, simple, nine-patch, complex). Provides construction helpers, mutation (inset/outset/offset), containment checks, serialization to/from a fixed-size memory blob, and optional axis-aligned transformation. Methods ensure internal invariants (finite values, non-overlapping radii) and compute type accordingly.
Enumeration classifying the specialized shape of an SkRRect. Values progress from most restrictive (empty) to least restrictive (complex).
Enumeration indexing the four corners in storage order: upper-left, upper-right, lower-right, lower-left. Used to access per-corner radii.
2D vector with float components and common vector operations (dot, cross-magnitude, normalization, arithmetic). Provides raw pointer access to its contiguous components.
3D vector with float components supporting equality, dot, cross, normalization, and element-wise operations. Often used for axes, positions, and directions.
4D vector with float components (commonly homogeneous coordinates). Provides vector arithmetic, normalization, dot product, indexing, and raw pointer access.

4x4 column-major matrix used for 2D/3D transforms in Skia. Provides constructors for identity, NaN, row/column major input, translation/scale/rotation, look-at, perspective, and conversion to/from SkMatrix. Supports concatenation, inversion, transpose, mapping vectors, and normalization of perspective row.
Tag enum scoped inside SkM44 used to select the constructor that leaves matrix elements uninitialized.
Tag enum scoped inside SkM44 used to select the constructor that fills all matrix elements with NaN.

3x3 transformation matrix class for 2D graphics supporting translate, scale, skew, rotate, and perspective. Provides rich API to construct, compose, decompose, and map points/vectors/rects. Includes type masks and caching for performance. Ownership: standalone value type with internal array fMat[9] and cached type mask.
Enum controlling how a matrix maps one rectangle to another: fill, start (align min edges), center, or end (align max edges). Nested within SkMatrix.
Bitmask enum describing the general form of a matrix (identity, translate, scale, affine, perspective). Used for fast-path decisions and cached in SkMatrix.

Compressed 2D rotation+scale transform with translation, storing scaled cosine and sine (fSCos, fSSin) and translation (fTx, fTy). Represents matrix [[fSCos, -fSSin, fTx],[fSSin, fSCos, fTy],[0,0,1]]. Provides factory constructors including Make and MakeFromRadians (with scale, radians, translation, and anchor adjustments), mutators (set, setIdentity), a quick rectangular-preservation test, and geometry helpers to map a width/height or SkSize into a transformed quad or triangle strip. Definitions for toQuad/toTriStrip are declared here but implemented elsewhere. Ownership: standalone POD-like struct; not owned by other types in this header.

Strongly-typed enum indicating the fill rule for SkPath geometry, including non-inverse and inverse variants. kDefault equals kWinding. Utility inline helpers in this header provide checks/toggles for even-odd and inverse flags.
Strongly-typed enum specifying winding direction when adding closed contours to a path. kDefault equals kCW.
Bitmask enum representing which segment types are present in a path (line, quad, conic, cubic). Intended for bitwise combination to describe a set of segment kinds.
Strongly-typed enum describing verb/opcode of path segments as produced by SkPath::RawIter. Encodes the primitive type and implied point/weight arity. kLast_Verb aliases kClose.

Primary path geometry class representing sequences of move/line/quad/conic/cubic and close verbs. Owns arrays of points, verbs, and conic weights with lazy caches for bounds/convexity. Provides construction helpers (rect/oval/rrect/polygon), transforms, iteration, serialization, containment, and various queries. Managed by shared SkPathData internally. Destruction is automatic; copies are cheap (copy-on-write).
Record returned by path iterators that bundles the current verb, a span of points relevant to that verb, and the conic weight when applicable.

Public iterator over a SkPath that yields verbs and associated points, with options to force-close contours and skip degenerates. Provides both legacy array-based and std::optional<IterRec> iteration.
Public, lower-level iterator that exposes raw path stream data with minimal processing. Intended to be replaced by Iter; kept for compatibility.
Enum controlling how a source path is appended to a destination path: either as a new contour (append) or by extending the last contour (extend).
Bitmask enum indicating which segment types (line/quad/conic/cubic) are present in a path. Used by getSegmentMasks().
Legacy verb enum mirroring SkPathVerb values with an extra kDone_Verb sentinel used by iterators.

Path-construction utility class for incrementally building an SkPath. Provides a rich set of APIs to append moves, lines, quadratic/conic/cubic curves, arcs, and common shapes, as well as transforms, bounds computation, and serialization helpers. Owns internal arrays of points, verbs, and conic weights; can snapshot or detach into an SkPath or SkPathData. Contains nested enum ArcSize and enum class DumpFormat for arc selection and dump formatting.
Enumeration inside SkPathBuilder that selects the small or large arc when resolving elliptical-arc ambiguity. Used by arcTo/rArcTo overloads.
Scoped enum inside SkPathBuilder controlling textual dump formatting of path data (decimal vs hex). Used by dumpToString/dump methods.

Abstract base class for path effects in Skia. A SkPathEffect modifies the geometry of a path before the canvas transform is applied, e.g., dashing or composition of effects. It is refcounted via SkFlattenable and supports serialization. Key operations include filtering a source SkPath into a destination via SkPathBuilder while possibly modifying the provided SkStrokeRec, optionally using the current transform matrix (CTM). MakeSum applies two effects independently and sums their results; MakeCompose applies inner then outer. needsCTM indicates whether a valid CTM must be supplied to filterPath. Construction is via static factory and deserialization; direct instantiation is private.

Stroke parameter record for Skia. Encapsulates stroke style, width, join, cap, miter limit, and resolution scale, and can apply those to paths/paints or compute inflation radius. Provides two nested enums (InitStyle and Style). Construction from InitStyle or from SkPaint plus style/resolution. Details such as exact path stroking algorithm are not in this header.
Initialization mode for SkStrokeRec constructors: start as hairline or as fill.
Represents the effective stroke/fill style stored in SkStrokeRec: hairline, fill, stroke, or stroke-and-fill.
Enumeration controlling the base filtering between texels: nearest-neighbor or bilinear. kLast is an internal sentinel equal to kLinear; kSkFilterModeCount gives the number of valid modes.
Enumeration controlling how mipmap levels are selected or blended during sampling. kLast is an internal sentinel equal to kLinear; kSkMipmapModeCount gives the number of valid modes.
Parameters (B, C) for cubic reconstruction filters used during image sampling. Provides named presets for Mitchell and Catmull-Rom kernels.

Configuration struct describing how an image should be sampled: anisotropy level, whether to use a cubic resampler (and its parameters), base filter mode, and mipmap mode. Provides multiple constructors and a named constructor Aniso() to enable anisotropic sampling with at least 1x. All data members are const, making the struct immutable after construction.

objects.definition:
enum SkYUVColorSpace : int {
    kJPEG_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kRec601_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kRec709_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kRec709_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kBT2020_8bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kBT2020_8bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kBT2020_10bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kBT2020_10bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kBT2020_12bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kBT2020_12bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kBT2020_16bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kBT2020_16bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kFCC_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kFCC_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kSMPTE240_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kSMPTE240_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYDZDX_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYDZDX_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kGBR_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kGBR_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYCgCo_8bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYCgCo_8bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYCgCo_10bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYCgCo_10bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYCgCo_12bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYCgCo_12bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYCgCo_16bit_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kYCgCo_16bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kIdentity_SkYUVColorSpace,

    kLastEnum_SkYUVColorSpace = kIdentity_SkYUVColorSpace,

    // Legacy (deprecated) names:
    kJPEG_SkYUVColorSpace = kJPEG_Full_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kRec601_SkYUVColorSpace = kRec601_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kRec709_SkYUVColorSpace = kRec709_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
    kBT2020_SkYUVColorSpace = kBT2020_8bit_Limited_SkYUVColorSpace,
};
objects.description: Enumeration of YUV-to-RGB matrix/range conventions. Encodes whether YUV data is full or limited range and which standard’s transform is used (JPEG, Rec.601/709, BT.2020 variants, FCC, SMPTE240, identity, etc.).

Small value-type-like class describing pixel encoding: color type, alpha type, and optional color space. Provides queries, equality, and factories to tweak components. Used by SkImageInfo to separate color description from dimensions.

POD-like struct describing an image’s dimensions plus its color description (via embedded SkColorInfo). Provides many static factory constructors for common formats, queries, and helpers for row bytes, byte size, and variant creation with different color/alpha/space.

objects.definition: using ReleaseContext = void*;
objects.description: Alias for an opaque client-provided pointer-sized context value used with SkImages raster release callbacks.

objects.definition: using RasterReleaseProc = void(const void* pixels, ReleaseContext);
objects.description: Function type for a callback invoked when an SkImage no longer references shared raster pixels provided by the client. Receives the pixel pointer and the client-supplied ReleaseContext.
Enumeration selecting the per-channel storage precision when rasterizing a picture into an image: 8-bit unsigned integer or 16-bit float.

Primary immutable image type representing 2D pixel data that may be backed by raster memory, encoded data, or GPU textures. Provides query, readback, rescaling, color space conversion, shader creation, and subset APIs. It is reference-counted (via SkRefCnt) and has several pure virtuals implemented by backends. Construction is via factory functions in the SkImages namespace (not by subclassing).

Abstract result container for asynchronous pixel read operations from SkImage, possibly multi-planar (e.g., YUV). Provides plane count, data pointer, and rowBytes per plane. Lifetime ends when the unique_ptr passed to the read callback is destroyed.

objects.definition: using ReadPixelsContext = void*;
objects.description: Client-provided opaque pointer passed back to the async read callback for context/state.

objects.definition: using ReadPixelsCallback = void(ReadPixelsContext, std::unique_ptr<const AsyncReadResult>);
objects.description: Function type for async read completion callbacks. Receives the client context and a unique_ptr to the AsyncReadResult (or nullptr on failure).

objects.definition: enum class RescaleGamma : bool { kSrc, kLinear };
objects.description: Indicates whether rescaling occurs in the image’s source gamma or after converting to linear gamma.
Specifies the filtering strategy used when rescaling in async read operations.
Controls whether Skia may internally cache pixel data produced during read/scale operations.
Small POD specifying constraints that a produced image must satisfy, currently whether mipmaps are required.
Deprecated enum controlling characteristics of a legacy bitmap extracted from an SkImage (currently read-only immutable).

Lightweight, non-owning view over pixel memory described by an SkImageInfo. It pairs a pixel pointer and row stride with image metadata and provides helpers to read, write, iterate, subset, copy, and scale pixel data. Memory for pixels is owned externally; SkPixmap never frees it. Construction is via default or info/pointer/rowBytes; can be reset to point elsewhere. Many operations require compatible color/alpha/color space. Details like thread-safety and lifetime of SkColorSpace pointers follow Skia conventions. Destruction is trivial as it holds raw pointers and value types.

Two-dimensional raster pixel container that references pixel storage via SkPixelRef and describes pixels via SkImageInfo. Provides allocation, installation, read/write, subset/extract, and utility methods. Not thread-safe; multiple SkBitmap instances may share a SkPixelRef. Construction is via default/copy/move ctors or by allocating/installing pixels. Destruction decrements the pixel ref. Mutating color space/alpha or immutability flags affects shared SkPixelRef.

Abstract allocator interface used by SkBitmap to create and attach a SkPixelRef for its current SkImageInfo. Implement allocPixelRef to either call bitmap->setPixels(...) or bitmap->setPixelRef(...). Reference-counted via SkRefCnt.
Concrete Allocator that allocates pixel memory from the heap and attaches it to the provided SkBitmap (default allocator used by allocPixels()).
Obsolete allocation flags enum for SkBitmap allocation APIs. Only kZeroPixels_AllocFlag is defined and has no effect (pixels are always zeroed).

objects.definition: class SK_API SkCanvas { ... };
objects.description: Primary drawing interface that manages a stack of transforms (matrices) and clipping, and issues drawing operations to an underlying SkDevice or surface. Provides numerous APIs for saving/restoring state, clipping, transforming, and drawing primitives, images, text, and meshes. This header provides the full class declaration with many virtual hooks for subclassing. Construction is via constructors for raster/bitmap-backed canvases or static MakeRasterDirect helpers.

Bit flags controlling saveLayer behavior. Preserve LCD text requests, initialize layer with previous contents, or force F16 color type. SaveLayerFlags is the uint32_t bitmask type used with these flags.

Parameter bundle used to configure a saveLayer: optional bounds, paint to apply on restore, optional backdrop filter and color space, tile mode for backdrop sampling, optional side-car image filters list, and flags. Multiple constructors cover common permutations. Used by SkCanvas::saveLayer(const SaveLayerRec&).
Specifies how an array of points should be drawn: as discrete points, as independent line segments per pair, or as an open polyline.

Controls sampling behavior at the edges of the source rectangle for image drawing with filtering. Strict prevents sampling outside the src rect (disables mips/anisotropy) while Fast allows sampling outside for speed.

Defines a 9-patch or general lattice subdivision for image drawing. X/Y division arrays define grid lines; optional per-rect types can make regions transparent or filled with fixed colors. Used by drawImageLattice.

POD-like record describing one textured quad for the experimental image-set API: image handle, source and destination rects, optional per-entry pre-view matrix index, per-entry alpha, per-edge AA flags, and whether a per-entry clip quad follows.
Bitmask flags controlling per-edge antialiasing for experimental quad drawing APIs. Each bit toggles AA on the corresponding rectangle edge.

RAII helper that records a canvas's current save count on construction and restores to that count on destruction (and optionally saves once at construction). Ensures canvas state is restored even on early returns or exceptions.

SkPaint is a core Skia class encapsulating all per-draw paint state: color, stroke/fill style, joins, caps, width, miter, antialiasing, dithering, and references to effect/filter objects (shader, color filter, path effect, mask filter, image filter, blender). It manages SkRefCnt-based references to those effect objects. Provides API to query/modify style and compute fast bounds. Inner enumerations Style, Cap, and Join are part of this class's API.
direct_api_constructors: SkPaint(const SkColor4f& color, SkColorSpace* colorSpace = nullptr)

objects.description: Enumeration nested in SkPaint selecting how geometry is rendered: fill, stroke, or stroke-and-fill. Used with SkPaint::getStyle/setStyle and related logic.
Enumeration nested in SkPaint specifying the cap style at the ends of open stroked paths: butt, round, or square.
Enumeration nested in SkPaint specifying the join style at stroke corners: miter, round, or bevel. Includes sentinel aliases for last/default.

Immutable container of one or more text runs with associated font and positioning data, reference-counted. Provides construction helpers (MakeFrom*), serialization, iteration over runs, and cache notification. Memory is custom-allocated (sk_malloc/sk_free). Details of internal RunRecord and GlyphPositioning are private to the .cpp.
Iterator over the runs contained in an SkTextBlob. Provides stable Run metadata and an experimental API exposing font and per-glyph positions. Constructed with a blob and advanced with next().
POD describing a single run when iterating: the typeface, glyph count, and glyph indices. Some optional testing fields may appear under a build flag.
Experimental iteration payload exposing SkFont, glyph ids, and per-glyph positions for a run. Marked experimental and may change or be removed.

Mutable helper to build SkTextBlob instances by allocating runs of glyphs with various positioning modes (default, posH, pos, RSXform) and optional UTF-8 text/cluster data. Owns a temporary storage arena until make() is called, which finalizes and resets the builder.
Writable buffers returned by SkTextBlobBuilder allocation methods. The caller fills glyph ids, positions (shape depends on mode), and optionally UTF-8 text and cluster indices.

objects.definition: using SkTypefaceID = uint32_t;
objects.description: Alias for a 32-bit unsigned integer used as a unique identifier for a typeface instance. Values are non-zero per uniqueID().

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t SkFontTableTag;
objects.description: Machine-endian 4-byte tag identifying a font table (commonly TrueType/OpenType table tags).
Controls how SkTypeface::serialize encodes data: always embed font data, never embed, or embed only if the data is local.
A simple pair of a string value and its BCP-47-like language tag, used to enumerate localized family names.
Abstract iterator over localized family names. Call next() repeatedly until it returns false. Ownership is manual via unref().

objects.definition: using FactoryId = SkFourByteTag;
objects.description: Alias for a four-byte tag used to register SkTypeface factories for deserialization.

Abstract, reference-counted type representing an immutable font face with style, table access, glyph mapping, variation parameters, serialization, and scaler context creation. Subclasses must implement numerous virtuals to provide backend/manager-specific behavior. Thread-safe to share. Construction is via factory methods or subclass constructors; destruction via ref-counting inherited from SkWeakRefCnt.

Represents a compact, value-type description of a font's style in Skia, combining weight, width, and slant into a 32-bit encoded integer. Provides constructors, comparison, accessors, and common presets (Normal, Bold, Italic, BoldItalic). It clamps inputs to defined ranges using SkTPin. No heap management is required; this is a small trivially copyable-like class with an internal int32 encoding.

objects.definition:
enum Weight {
        kInvisible_Weight   =    0,
        kThin_Weight        =  100,
        kExtraLight_Weight  =  200,
        kLight_Weight       =  300,
        kNormal_Weight      =  400,
        kMedium_Weight      =  500,
        kSemiBold_Weight    =  600,
        kBold_Weight        =  700,
        kExtraBold_Weight   =  800,
        kBlack_Weight       =  900,
        kExtraBlack_Weight  = 1000,
    };
objects.description: Enumeration of font weight values used by SkFontStyle. Values map to conventional numeric weights from 0 (invisible) to 1000 (extra black).

objects.definition:
enum Width {
        kUltraCondensed_Width   = 1,
        kExtraCondensed_Width   = 2,
        kCondensed_Width        = 3,
        kSemiCondensed_Width    = 4,
        kNormal_Width           = 5,
        kSemiExpanded_Width     = 6,
        kExpanded_Width         = 7,
        kExtraExpanded_Width    = 8,
        kUltraExpanded_Width    = 9,
    };
objects.description: Enumeration of font width (stretch) categories used by SkFontStyle, from ultra condensed (1) to ultra expanded (9).
Enumeration of font slant options used by SkFontStyle: upright, italic, or oblique. Stored as an 8-bit value.

Primary font object controlling size, scaling, skew, hinting, edging, and other text rendering/measurement options in Skia. Provides APIs to convert text to glyphs, measure, position, and outline glyphs, and query font metrics. Details like construction, mutation, and usage are fully defined here; destructor and method bodies are in the implementation file.
direct_api_constructors: SkFont::SkFont(sk_sp<SkTypeface> typeface, SkScalar size, SkScalar scaleX, SkScalar skewX)

objects.description: Public nested enum of SkFont selecting edge rendering mode for glyphs: aliased, antialiased, or subpixel antialiasing.

Abstract ref-counted interface representing a set of font styles (family member faces). Provides enumeration, querying style info, and creating/matching SkTypeface instances within the set. Subclasses must implement the pure virtuals and typically back them with a platform font database.

Abstract ref-counted font manager providing access to system or custom font collections. Public methods forward to protected pure-virtual hooks that platform/back-end implementations must override. Can enumerate families, retrieve style sets, match families/styles/characters, and construct SkTypeface instances from data, streams, or files.

Top-level value type that packages user-specified arguments for selecting and configuring a font: the collection index within a font collection, an optional variation design-space position, and an optional color palette selection with overrides. Designed to be populated and passed into font-loading APIs. The object holds non-owning pointers to variation coordinates and palette overrides; the pointed-to data must outlive the SkFontArguments instance.

Describes a position in a variable font’s design space as an array of axis/value coordinates. The coordinates pointer is not owned/copied; it must remain valid for the lifetime of any SkFontArguments using it. Axes not provided default to the font’s defaults; unknown axes are ignored.
Single axis coordinate within the variation design space: a four-byte axis tag and its float value.

Specifies a color palette selection for a COLR/CPAL-enabled font and an optional list of per-entry overrides. Holds a palette index and a pointer to override pairs. The overrides pointer is non-owning; data must outlive the SkFontArguments that references it.
Override entry mapping a palette entry index to a replacement SkColor. Later overrides supersede earlier ones; out-of-range indices are ignored by consumers.

Strongly-typed enum selecting how text data passed into font/shaping APIs is encoded: UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 16-bit code units, UTF-32 32-bit code points, or direct glyph IDs. Details beyond comments are not provided in this header.

Strongly-typed enum controlling font hinting strength: none, slight, normal, or full. Influences how glyph outlines are adjusted for rasterization. Further usage details are not specified in this header.

Struct representing the font metrics for an SkFont in Skia’s y-down coordinate system. Includes ascent/descent, bounds, average/max widths, x-height, cap height, underline and strikeout metrics, plus flags indicating which values are valid. Methods provide validated accessors for underline/strikeout metrics and bounds, and operator== for equality. Lifetime is plain POD; initialize and fill via SkFont APIs elsewhere. Some fields may be deprecated or unknown depending on the font (e.g., bounds with variable fonts).

Abstract base class for image filters in Skia. It defines a DAG of filter nodes that process offscreen rendered content before compositing. Provides APIs for bounds mapping, color-filter introspection, input traversal, fast-bounds computation, local-matrix adaptation, and deserialization. Construction is via factory functions or deserialization; lifetime is ref-counted via SkRefCnt (through SkFlattenable). Details of evaluation, inputs storage, and destruction are defined in the implementation, not in this header.
Enumeration used by SkImageFilter to indicate the mapping direction for bounds queries: forward (map source to destination coverage) or reverse (map destination to required source).

Abstract base class for shaders that produce premultiplied source colors for drawing. Provides queries (e.g., isOpaque, isAImage) and methods to derive modified shaders with a local matrix, a color filter, or explicit working color spaces. Instances are typically created via factory functions in SkShaders or other Skia APIs; this header does not expose public constructors. Lifetime is managed via ref-counting (sk_sp).

Abstract base class for color filter objects in Skia’s drawing pipeline. A SkColorFilter transforms source colors to new colors and can be composed with other filters. Thread-safe for concurrent use. It is a SkFlattenable, so it supports serialization. Construction typically occurs via factory helpers in SkColorFilters or deserialization.

Namespace-like utility class providing factory functions to create SkColorFilter instances (composition, blending, matrix/HSLA transformations, gamma conversions, lookup-table filters, and lighting). Not instantiable; only static methods are provided.

objects.definition: enum class Clamp : bool { kNo, kYes };
objects.description: Scoped enum nested in SkColorFilters selecting whether matrix filters clamp results to the 0..1 range. Values: kNo, kYes.

Base class for mask filters that transform a mask before drawing (e.g., blurring). Provides factory methods to create a blur mask filter and to deserialize a filter. Inherits from SkFlattenable for serialization support. Construction is via static factories; direct instantiation is not exposed here.

A Skia flattenable class representing a custom blend function that combines a source color (paint result) and a destination color (canvas) into a final color. Constructed via factory methods returning sk_sp<SkBlender>. The default constructor is private; instances are typically obtained via Mode() or other APIs outside this header. Details of blending are governed by SkBlendMode and SkFlattenable serialization. Ownership is via reference-counted sk_sp.
Enumeration describing intended client access to a backend surface when creating or using SkSurface utilities in the SkSurfaces namespace.

objects.definition:
namespace SkSurfaces {

using PixelsReleaseProc = void(void* pixels, void* context);
objects.description: Function type for a callback invoked when a pixel buffer, provided to WrapPixels(), can be released. The function receives the original pixels pointer and a user context.
Enumeration used with SkSurface::notifyContentWillChange() to indicate whether existing content should be discarded or retained when external modifications are about to occur.
Enumeration describing required access semantics when obtaining or interacting with a backend handle for a surface (read, write, or overwrite). Includes legacy alias names as constants.
Opaque pointer type passed to SkSurface texture release callbacks. Carries user-defined context data.
Function pointer type for callbacks invoked when a backend texture provided to SkSurface::replaceBackendTexture() can be released by the client.
Alias to SkImage::AsyncReadResult exposed by SkSurface for async read APIs. Represents the result container for asynchronous pixel reads. Definition is not in this header.
Opaque pointer type passed back to the client's read-pixels callback to carry user state.
Function type for callbacks invoked when asynchronous pixel read or rescale operations complete. Receives the user context and a unique_ptr to the AsyncReadResult (or nullptr on failure).
Type aliases mirroring SkImage::RescaleGamma and SkImage::RescaleMode for use with SkSurface async rescale/read APIs. Definitions are in SkImage; this header only aliases them.
Alias to SkImage::RescaleMode used by SkSurface’s async rescale/read APIs. Definition is external to this header.

Abstract drawing destination managing pixel storage either in CPU memory or on a GPU backend. Provides a managed SkCanvas, snapshotting, pixel read/write APIs, async read/rescale utilities, and GPU synchronization helpers. Do not subclass outside Skia; creation is via factory functions in SkSurfaces or other APIs. Some methods depend on GPU backends; behavior may be limited on raster surfaces.

Enumeration describing LCD subpixel geometry for pixels. Used to inform text/rasterization about RGB/BGR ordering and horizontal/vertical stripe orientation. kUnknown_SkPixelGeometry indicates unknown or geometry-agnostic content.

Properties and constraints for an SkSurface. Encapsulates rendering flags, LCD subpixel geometry, and text mask contrast/gamma to allow engines to optimize or alter rendering. Constructible with default or explicit flags/geometry/contrast/gamma. Equality operators provided. Flags include device-independent fonts, dynamic MSAA, always dither, and preserving transparent draws.

Abstract reference-counted picture object that records and can later replay SkCanvas drawing commands. Provides serialization/deserialization, approximate metrics, shader creation, and a unique ID. Construction is via static factory methods; direct construction is private. Subclasses implement playback, cullRect, and metrics.
Abstract callback type used to optionally abort SkPicture playback early. Implement abort() to return true when playback should stop. Non-copyable.

A recording utility that captures SkCanvas drawing commands into an SkRecord and produces either an immutable SkPicture or a live SkDrawable snapshot. It manages a culling rectangle and optional bounding box hierarchy to accelerate playback/culling. Begin with beginRecording(...), draw via the returned SkCanvas, then finalize with one of the finishRecording* methods. The class owns internal recording state and becomes invalid for recording after finishing until beginRecording is called again.

Reference-counted immutable/semimutably-internal data buffer wrapper. Holds a fixed-size byte span for its lifetime. Provides copying, sharing subsets, and factory constructors from memory, files, file descriptors, and streams. Callers may obtain a writable pointer prior to additional refs to initialize newly created buffers. Custom deallocation can be provided via ReleaseProc when the data is externally owned. Lifetime is managed via SkNVRefCnt (intrusive ref counting).

objects.definition: typedef void (*ReleaseProc)(const void* ptr, void* context);
objects.description: Function pointer type used to release externally provided memory when an SkData instance is destroyed. Receives the original data pointer and an opaque context pointer supplied at construction.

Abstract readable byte stream. Base class for memory/file/other-backed input sources. Provides reading, optional peeking, end-of-stream detection, optional rewinding/duplicating/forking, and optional seeking/length/memory access. Concrete subclasses must implement at least read() and isAtEnd().
Abstract SkStream that guarantees rewind() and duplicate(). Used when sources can be reset to the beginning and cloned.
Abstract readable stream that is rewindable and supports random access (getPosition/seek/move) and forking.
Abstract seekable stream with a known total length. Base of file and memory asset streams.
Abstract stream representing in-memory readable data, exposing a base pointer via getMemoryBase().
Abstract writable byte stream. Provides write/flush/bytesWritten and many helpers for writing primitive types and copying from SkStream.
Writable sink that discards all data but counts the number of bytes written. Useful for sizing.
Concrete seekable asset stream backed by a C FILE*. Supports reading, rewind/seek/move, duplicate/fork, and reports length. Manages FILE lifecycle via shared_ptr in implementations.
Concrete in-memory read-only stream over SkData or raw memory. Supports copying or taking ownership, reading/peeking, rewind/seek/move, duplicate/fork, and exposes base pointer.
Writable stream that outputs to a file path using C stdio FILE*. Provides fsync/flush and reports total bytes written.
Growable in-memory write stream that accumulates bytes in internal Blocks. Supports reading back, copying/detaching to SkData/vector/stream, and efficient transfer/reset operations.

Reference-counted, lightweight UTF-8 string class similar to std::string, optimized for cheap copies via shared internal storage. Provides construction from C strings, std::string, and string_view, plus rich mutation and formatting APIs. Internally holds a sk_sp to an inline-allocated Rec buffer with length and atomic ref-count.

Base reference-counted document abstraction that manages multi-page output to an SkWStream. Clients call beginPage/endPage/close/abort; subclasses implement onBeginPage/onEndPage/onClose/onAbort to generate a concrete document format. The SkDocument owns the active SkCanvas between beginPage and endPage/close. Subclasses must call close() in their destructor.

Describes the layout of multi-plane YUVA image data (planar configuration, chroma subsampling, siting, color space, and origin). It does not contain pixel data; it provides utilities to compute plane dimensions, subsampling factors, and channel mappings for textures/pixmaps holding Y, U, V, and optional A data.
direct_api_constructors: SkYUVAInfo(SkISize, PlaneConfig, Subsampling, SkYUVColorSpace, SkEncodedOrigin, Siting, Siting)

objects.definition: struct YUVALocation;
objects.description: Opaque/internal per-channel location descriptor used to map Y, U, V, A channels into planes. Only a forward declaration is present in this header; the structure definition is not provided here.

objects.definition:
enum class PlaneConfig {
        kUnknown,
        kY_U_V,
        kY_V_U,
        kY_UV,
        kY_VU,
        kYUV,
        kUYV,
        kY_U_V_A,
        kY_V_U_A,
        kY_UV_A,
        kY_VU_A,
        kYUVA,
        kUYVA,
        kLast = kUYVA
    };
objects.description: Enumerates how Y, U, V, and optional A channels are distributed among 1–4 planes and their ordering within planes.
Enumerates chroma subsampling schemes for U and V relative to Y using J:a:b notation (e.g., 4:2:0, 4:4:4).
Specifies chroma siting relative to luma for subsampled formats. Only centered siting is currently defined.

objects.definition: enum YUVAChannels { kY, kU, kV, kA, kLast = kA };
objects.description: Legacy/plain enum listing Y, U, V, and A channel identifiers and a terminal kLast value.

Describes the per-plane pixmap layout for a YUVA image: plane ImageInfos, row bytes, and a unified channel DataType, paired with an SkYUVAInfo. It validates compatibility and can compute sizes and initialize SkPixmap views over a single allocation. Inner types include DataType (channel storage type) and SupportedDataTypes (capability mask).
direct_api_constructors: SkYUVAPixmapInfo::SkYUVAPixmapInfo(const SkYUVAInfo&, const SkColorType[kMaxPlanes], const size_t rowBytes[kMaxPlanes])
SkYUVAPixmapInfo::SkYUVAPixmapInfo(const SkYUVAInfo&, DataType, const size_t rowBytes[kMaxPlanes])

objects.description: Enumerates per-channel storage type for Y, U, V, and optional A across planes: 8-bit, 16-bit unorm, 16-bit float, or 10-bit unorm with 2-bit alpha packing.
Bitmask helper indicating which DataType-and-channel-count combinations are supported for YUVA plane configurations. Provides All(), supported(...), and enableDataType(...).

Container that holds SkPixmap planes laid out per SkYUVAPixmapInfo. It can allocate and own memory, wrap SkData, wrap external memory, or wrap external SkPixmaps. Provides plane access, validity checks, and conversion to YUVALocations.

Immutable vertex container used by SkCanvas::drawVertices. Holds positions, optional texture coordinates, colors, and optional indices. Reference-counted via SkNVRefCnt. Provides factory MakeCopy to copy client data and a Builder for incremental construction. Stores bounds, counts, and drawing mode. Memory is internally managed; pointers fPositions/fTexs/fColors/fIndices refer into the SkVertices allocation and must not be freed by callers. Destruction is via ref counting; custom operator delete indicates custom allocation sizing.

Helper to incrementally build a SkVertices object by writing directly into allocated arrays for positions, optional indices, optional texCoords, and optional colors based on flags. Use detach() to obtain the finalized SkVertices; after detach, the Builder yields null on subsequent detach calls. Validity can be checked with isValid().
Enumeration of primitive assembly modes for vertices: independent triangles, triangle strip, and triangle fan. kLast_VertexMode aliases the last valid value.
Bitfield flags passed to SkVertices::Builder to request storage for texCoords and/or per-vertex colors.

A 3D point/vector type holding three SkScalar components (fX, fY, fZ). Provides constructors/factory, accessors, arithmetic operations, normalization, length, dot and cross products, scaling, and validity checks. Acts as the underlying type for SkVector3 and SkColor3f aliases. Construction is trivial (POD-like); normalize() and Length() are declared here but implemented elsewhere. No ownership semantics beyond simple value type.

Reference-counted object that measures a single non-zero-length contour of an SkPath. Provides length queries, position/tangent evaluation, matrix generation, segment extraction, and verb-wise iteration of the contour. Owns precomputed segment and point arrays and records whether the contour is closed.
Lightweight struct describing one path verb on the measured contour: cumulative distance at the verb, verb type, and the points involved.
Input-iterator used to iterate over verbs on the contour measured by SkContourMeasure, yielding VerbMeasure values in forward order.
Bitfield enum controlling which parts of the transformation matrix to compute when calling SkContourMeasure::getMatrix.

Iterator that produces SkContourMeasure objects for each non-zero-length contour of a path. Owns an internal implementation object and supports default construction, move semantics, reset with a path, and iteration via next().
direct_api_constructors: SkContourMeasureIter(const SkPath& path, bool forceClosed, SkScalar resScale = 1)

objects.description: Iterator over a pre-parsed path representation. It walks parallel spans of points, verbs, and conic weights, yielding segments via next() and allowing a lookahead via peekNextVerb(). The iterator trims a trailing kMove verb for compatibility. Ownership: it does not own the underlying spans; the client must ensure lifetime of the provided spans for the duration of iteration.
direct_api_constructors: SkPathIter(SkSpan<const SkPoint>, SkSpan<const SkPathVerb>, SkSpan<const float>)

objects.description: Record returned by SkPathIter::next() describing a single path element: its verb, the span of points it references, and a conic weight when the verb is kConic. The conicWeight() helper asserts the verb is kConic.

Iterator that yields contours (subpaths) from the same parallel spans of points, verbs, and conic weights. Each call to next() returns a Rec describing one contiguous contour. It does not own the data; the caller must ensure the spans outlive the iterator.
direct_api_constructors: SkPathContourIter(SkSpan<const SkPoint>, SkSpan<const SkPathVerb>, SkSpan<const float>)

objects.description: Record returned by SkPathContourIter::next() describing a single contour via spans covering its points, verbs, and conic weights.

Region type used for integer-pixel clipping and boolean operations over sets of rectangles. Internally stores either a single rect or RLE runs. Provides operations (set, op, contains/intersects, translate) and nested iterators for enumerating rectangles, clipped rectangles, or horizontal spans. Details such as memory layout are private and managed via RunHead. Destruction and copying are value-semantics with shared storage and copy-on-write behavior. Unknowns: exact RunHead layout is private to this header and defined elsewhere.
Iterator over the rectangles that compose a SkRegion, in y-then-x order. Used to enumerate constituent rects.
Iterator that enumerates rectangles of a SkRegion intersected with a given clip rectangle.
Iterator over horizontal spans where a given scanline y intersects a SkRegion, optionally limited to [left, right).
Enumeration of boolean set operations for combining regions: difference, intersect, union, xor, reverse-difference, replace. Note: pointer type shown for uniformity; typically used by value.

Singleton-style utility class providing global initialization and cache/resource controls for Skia. All methods are static; no instances are expected to be created. It exposes APIs to set/query font and resource cache limits, purge caches, dump memory statistics, and install runtime factories for image generation from encoded data and OpenType SVG decoding.

objects.definition:
using ImageGeneratorFromEncodedDataFactory =
            std::unique_ptr<SkImageGenerator> (*)(sk_sp<const SkData>);
objects.description: Type alias for a function pointer that, given encoded SkData, returns a heap-owned SkImageGenerator used by Skia to instantiate images from encoded data at runtime.

objects.definition:
using OpenTypeSVGDecoderFactory =
            std::unique_ptr<SkOpenTypeSVGDecoder> (*)(const uint8_t* svg, size_t length);
objects.description: Type alias for a function pointer that produces an SkOpenTypeSVGDecoder from a byte span containing OpenType SVG data. Used by Skia typefaces to decode and draw SVG glyphs when provided.

Utility class providing static parsing helpers for Skia-related text inputs. It locates and converts substrings into colors, integers, scalars, booleans, and lists. No instances are required or constructed; all functionality is via static methods. Construction/destruction details are not applicable as the class holds no state in this header.

Utility class providing conversion between SVG path data strings and SkPath objects. Offers a modern factory-style parser that returns std::optional<SkPath> and a deprecated boolean-returning overload that fills an out parameter. Also provides an encoder that emits an SVG path data string from an SkPath with either absolute or relative commands.

objects.definition: enum class PathEncoding { Absolute, Relative };
objects.description: Enumeration selecting the command coordinate mode when serializing an SkPath to an SVG path string: Absolute uses absolute commands; Relative uses relative commands.

Bitmask enumeration of flags that control shadow rendering behavior in SkShadowUtils APIs, such as occluder opacity optimization, geometric-only rendering, directional light handling, and concave-path fallback to blur.
Utility class providing static functions to draw and query shadows for paths, and to compute tonal alpha shadow colors. It is not meant to be instantiated; all APIs are static.

Utility class providing static helpers to draw text onto an SkCanvas or to build an SkPath for text. It centralizes baseline-aligned rendering with a specified alignment (left, center, right) and supports multiple text encodings via SkTextEncoding. No instances are constructed; all members are static.
Enumeration inside SkTextUtils selecting horizontal text alignment for rendering and path generation: left, center, or right. Used as a parameter to SkTextUtils methods.

objects.definition: struct SkIRect;
objects.description: Forward declaration of an integer rectangle type. Only a declaration is provided here; its layout and members are defined elsewhere.

A SkCanvas subclass that performs no rasterization. Useful for analyzing draw calls with conservative rectangle-only clipping and no backing pixels. All draw methods are overridden as no-ops; state-reset helpers are provided. Construction requires dimensions or an SkIRect. Destruction/ownership follows SkCanvas conventions. Detailed behavior of base types (e.g., SaveLayerStrategy) is defined elsewhere.

objects.definition: class SkCanvas;
objects.description: Forward declaration of SkCanvas. Not defined in this header; serves only to declare the type so it can be referenced. Details such as members and behavior are unknown here.

Alias-like pointer form for the factory return type. Note: This is not a custom type defined here; included for completeness around construction. The actual template type std::unique_ptr<SkCanvas> is from the C++ standard library and is not defined in this header.

A multi-destination Skia canvas that forwards every canvas operation it receives to a set of child SkCanvas instances. Owns an array of SkCanvas* (not ref-counted here) and mirrors all draw/clip/transform/save/restore calls. Construction requires width and height. Lifetimes of added SkCanvas objects are managed externally; this class does not assume ownership unless documented elsewhere. Iter is forward-declared as a nested class with no definition in this header.

Primary codec abstraction class for decoding encoded images in Skia. Provides APIs to create codecs from streams or data, decode to pixels, YUVA planes, handle incremental and scanline decoding, scaling, subsets, and multi-frame/animated images. Subclasses implement format-specific behavior via virtual methods. Ownership of input streams is managed by SkCodec. Construction is via static factory functions.
Options controlling decoding: zero-initialization hints, optional subset rect, target frame index and prior frame hint for animations, and an optional max memory budget.
Per-frame metadata for multi-frame/animated images: dependency on prior frame, display duration, completeness, alpha info, disposal and blend methods, and affected rectangle.

Runtime-registrable decoder descriptor used to extend SkCodec discovery. Holds an ID string and callbacks to identify a format and create a codec from a stream. Utilities in SkCodecs namespace include Register and DeferredImage.
Deprecated enum within SkAndroidCodec specifying how EXIF orientation should be handled by older APIs. SkAndroidCodec now ignores orientation and clients must handle it themselves.
Options struct specific to SkAndroidCodec decoding that extends SkCodec::Options, adding fSampleSize to request integer downscaling during decode. Default fSampleSize is 1 (no downscale).

Abstract interface for Android-specific image decoding built atop SkCodec. Provides factory constructors from codec/stream/data, helpers to compute output color characteristics and sampling, subset support, and decode entry points that accept AndroidOptions. Non-copyable; lifetime managed via std::unique_ptr and ref-counted Sk* collaborators. Concrete decoders must derive and implement onGetSampledDimensions, onGetSupportedSubset, and onGetAndroidPixels.

objects.definition:
enum class SkEncodedImageFormat {
    kBMP,
    kGIF,
    kICO,
    kJPEG,
    kPNG,
    kWBMP,
    kWEBP,
    kPKM,
    kKTX,
    kASTC,
    kDNG,
    kHEIF,
    kAVIF,
    kJPEGXL,
};
objects.description: Strongly-typed enum that identifies the file/bitstream format of encoded image data (e.g., BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, HEIF, AVIF, JPEG XL, etc.). Useful for selecting decoders/encoders or branching on container type. No associated constructors or ownership semantics apply; it is a value type.

objects.definition:
enum SkEncodedOrigin {
    kTopLeft_SkEncodedOrigin     = 1, // Default
    kTopRight_SkEncodedOrigin    = 2, // Reflected across y-axis
    kBottomRight_SkEncodedOrigin = 3, // Rotated 180
    kBottomLeft_SkEncodedOrigin  = 4, // Reflected across x-axis
    kLeftTop_SkEncodedOrigin     = 5, // Reflected across x-axis, Rotated 90 CCW
    kRightTop_SkEncodedOrigin    = 6, // Rotated 90 CW
    kRightBottom_SkEncodedOrigin = 7, // Reflected across x-axis, Rotated 90 CW
    kLeftBottom_SkEncodedOrigin  = 8, // Rotated 90 CCW
    kDefault_SkEncodedOrigin     = kTopLeft_SkEncodedOrigin,
    kLast_SkEncodedOrigin        = kLeftBottom_SkEncodedOrigin,
};
objects.description: Enumeration of EXIF orientation values for encoded images. Values match EXIF spec (1–8) and indicate how pixel data should be transformed to reach the correctly oriented display. Useful for choosing transform matrices and determining if width/height swap is required.

Forward declaration of SkPixmap, a pixel map class representing image pixel data. Only a forward declaration is present in this header; the full definition is elsewhere. Details about construction, lifetime, and usage are unknown from this file.

SkEncodedOrigin is referenced to indicate image EXIF orientation, but it is not defined in this header; its definition is in include/codec/SkEncodedOrigin.h. As it is not defined here, details are unknown and this entry should be ignored if strictly limiting to types defined in this file.

SkImageInfo describes image color/alpha type, dimensions, etc. It is referenced but not defined in this header; the full definition resides in include/core/SkImageInfo.h. As it is not defined here, details are unknown and this entry should be ignored if strictly limiting to types defined in this file.

Namespace-like utility class containing static factory functions to create SkImageFilter instances for common image-processing effects. Not instantiable (deleted constructor). Also defines nested types used by its APIs.

Lightweight optional crop rectangle wrapper for SkImageFilters factories. Inherits from std::optional<SkRect> and provides implicit conversions from SkIRect/SkRect and their pointers for backwards compatibility. Used to specify optional cropping on inputs/outputs.
Boolean-valued enum toggling dithering behavior for the Shader() factory in SkImageFilters.

Configuration struct for gradient interpolation behavior. Includes whether to interpolate in premultiplied alpha, which color space to interpolate in, and hue interpolation strategy for hue-based spaces. Provides constants for enum counts and a legacy FromFlags helper.

objects.definition: enum class InPremul : bool { kNo = false, kYes = true };
objects.description: Boolean enum specifying whether colors should be interpolated in premultiplied alpha.

objects.definition:
enum class ColorSpace : uint8_t {
            kDestination,
            kSRGBLinear,
            kLab,
            kOKLab,
            kOKLabGamutMap,
            kLCH,
            kOKLCH,
            kOKLCHGamutMap,
            kSRGB,
            kHSL,
            kHWB,
            kDisplayP3,
            kRec2020,
            kProphotoRGB,
            kA98RGB,
            kLastColorSpace = kA98RGB,
        };
objects.description: Enumeration of color spaces in which gradient interpolation may occur, including device destination space, linear sRGB, perceptual spaces (Lab/OKLab/LCH/OKLCH), HSL/HWB, and wide-gamut RGB spaces. Includes experimental gamut-mapped variants.
Hue interpolation strategy for hue-bearing spaces (LCH, OKLCH, HSL, HWB): choose shortest/longest arc or monotonic increasing/decreasing.

Helper class describing the color stops of a gradient: an array of SkColor4f colors, optional positions (same length as colors or empty for even distribution), an optional SkColorSpace for those colors, and a SkTileMode for edge behavior.

Container class bundling gradient color-stop specification (Colors) with interpolation configuration (Interpolation). Provides trivial constructors and accessors. No ownership semantics beyond storing provided data by value; Colors itself stores spans and a ref-counted SkColorSpace.

Factory host class for creating SkShader gradient variants (linear, radial, two-point conical, and sweep). It exposes static Make* functions and, when SK_SUPPORT_LEGACY_UNSPANNED_GRADIENTS is defined, a Flags enum affecting interpolation premultiplication. This header only declares the API; behavior and ownership are handled by returned sk_sp<SkShader>.

Color transform matrix class representing a 4x5 matrix (20 floats) used to transform RGBA color components. Provides constructors (default identity and element-wise), utilities for identity, scaling, translation (bias), concatenation, saturation adjustment, and accessors to set/get the matrix in row-major order. The storage is owned internally (std::array<float,20>). Static helpers convert between RGB and YUV color spaces given a SkYUVColorSpace. Lifetime is automatic; no special destruction needed.

Deprecated concrete SkColorFilter subclass that exposes a static factory method MakeLightingFilter delegating to SkColorFilters::Lighting(mul, add). Serves as a compatibility shim; no additional state or members defined here.

Public API class acting as a namespace for legacy blur/emboss mask filter factory functions. In this header it declares a single static constructor MakeEmboss that returns an SkMaskFilter. The class itself has no data members and is not intended to be instantiated; it only groups factory methods. Details about construction/destruction are not applicable beyond calling the static method when enabled by SK_SUPPORT_LEGACY_EMBOSSMASKFILTER.

SkDashPathEffect is a factory/helper class that constructs a dash-style SkPathEffect, which applies on/off dash patterns to stroked paths. It provides static Make functions that take an interval pattern and a phase and return a reference-counted SkPathEffect implementing the dash behavior. The intervals array alternates on/off lengths (must be even length >= 2). Phase is the starting offset modulo the sum of intervals. Only affects stroked paths. No instance data or non-static methods are defined here; usage is via the static Make constructors.

Runtime-compilable SkSL effect supporting creation of SkShader, SkColorFilter, or SkBlender objects. Provides reflection over uniforms and children, factory functions to compile from SkSL, and methods to instantiate runtime objects. Lifetime managed via SkRefCnt. Details like compilation flags and program internals are encapsulated.
Reflected metadata for a uniform variable in a runtime effect, including type, offset within the uniform block, array count, and flags (array, color, half precision, etc.).

objects.definition:
enum class Type {
    kFloat,
    kFloat2,
    kFloat3,
    kFloat4,
    kFloat2x2,
    kFloat3x3,
    kFloat4x4,
    kInt,
    kInt2,
    kInt3,
    kInt4,
};
objects.description: Enumeration of supported uniform data types for SkRuntimeEffect uniforms.
Identifies the kind of child object a runtime effect expects at a given child slot: shader, color filter, or blender.
Reflected metadata describing a child slot in a runtime effect: its name, required type, and index within the child array.
Compilation options for SkRuntimeEffect: toggles optimization, assigns a human-readable name, and contains private/internal controls (private access, stable key, max SkSL version).
Result of attempting to compile an SkRuntimeEffect: holds the effect on success or an error message on failure.
Type-erased holder for a child object passed to a runtime effect (shader, color filter, or blender). Ensures only allowed types are stored and queried.
Container pairing a shader instance with an SkSL debug trace to inspect CPU-side execution of a traced runtime shader.

Helper/builder that manages uniform storage and child assignment for a given SkRuntimeEffect and provides convenience methods to produce shaders, color filters, or blenders. Copyable, move-constructible; aliases provided for deprecated builder names.
Proxy for a specific uniform within a builder. Provides assignment and array-set helpers that write into the builder's uniform data block with size checks. No implicit type conversion.
Proxy for a specific child slot within a builder. Assigns sk_sp shader/colorFilter/blender (or null) into the correct slot, with debug validation.

objects.definition: using SkRuntimeShaderBuilder = SkRuntimeEffectBuilder;
objects.description: Deprecated alias for SkRuntimeEffectBuilder used for shaders.

objects.definition: using SkRuntimeColorFilterBuilder = SkRuntimeEffectBuilder;
objects.description: Deprecated alias for SkRuntimeEffectBuilder used for color filters.

objects.definition: using SkRuntimeBlendBuilder = SkRuntimeEffectBuilder;
objects.description: Deprecated alias for SkRuntimeEffectBuilder used for blenders.

Abstract base class for incremental image encoders. It manages row-by-row encoding from a source SkPixmap, tracking current progress and providing temporary storage. Clients call encodeRows(), which dispatches to the subclass implementation onEncodeRows(). Not copyable. Destruction is virtual. Construction is protected and requires a source pixmap and a storage size for internal buffer.

Nested struct representing a single frame for animated image encoding, holding the frame pixel data (SkPixmap) and its display duration in milliseconds. Used by SkEncoder implementations that support animation.

Alpha handling policy for JPEG encoding when the input has transparency. kIgnore treats input as opaque; kBlendOnBlack first composites over black. Details such as linear vs legacy blending are handled by the encoder; the header does not specify further options.
Chroma subsampling mode for JPEG encoding: k420 = 4:2:0 (halved in both directions), k422 = 4:2:2 (halved horizontally), k444 = 4:4:4 (no subsampling).
Configuration bundle for JPEG encoding. Controls quality [0..100], chroma subsampling, alpha handling policy, optional XMP metadata blob, and optional EXIF orientation (SkEncodedOrigin).
Enum class of PNG row filter strategy flags used by the encoder. Values can be bitwise-ORed via the provided operator|. kAll matches libpng’s default behavior of trying multiple filters per row.

objects.definition:
struct Options {
    /**
     *  Selects which filtering strategies to use.
     *
     *  If a single filter is chosen, libpng will use that filter for every row.
     *
     *  If multiple filters are chosen, libpng will use a heuristic to guess which filter
     *  will encode smallest, then apply that filter.  This happens on a per row basis,
     *  different rows can use different filters.
     *
     *  Using a single filter (or less filters) is typically faster.  Trying all of the
     *  filters may help minimize the output file size.
     *
     *  Our default value matches libpng's default.
     */
    FilterFlag fFilterFlags = FilterFlag::kAll;

    /**
     *  Must be in [0, 9] where 9 corresponds to maximal compression.  This value is passed
     *  directly to zlib.  0 is a special case to skip zlib entirely, creating dramatically
     *  larger pngs.
     *
     *  Our default value matches libpng's default.
     */
    int fZLibLevel = 6;

    /**
     *  Represents comments in the tEXt ancillary chunk of the png.
     *  The 2i-th entry is the keyword for the i-th comment,
     *  and the (2i + 1)-th entry is the text for the i-th comment.
     */
    sk_sp<SkDataTable> fComments;

    /**
     * Container for any HDR metadata to include in the encoded image.
     */
    skhdr::Metadata fHdrMetadata;

    /**
     * If non-null, then a gainmap and its metadata will be encoded as png chunks.
     * The gainmap will be encoded in a gmAP chunk as a full PNG container. The
     * gainmap info will be encoded in a gdAT chunk inside of the gmAP chunk.
     * This effectively is Option B proposed in this discussion for adding gainmaps
     * into PNG: https://github.com/w3c/png/issues/380#issuecomment-2325163149.
     *
     * Note that if fGainmapInfo is null, then fGainmap will fail to encode, as the
     * gainmap metadata is required to correctly interpret the encoded gainmap.
     */
    const SkPixmap* fGainmap = nullptr;
    const SkGainmapInfo* fGainmapInfo = nullptr;
};
objects.description: Options bag controlling PNG encoding behavior: row filter selection, zlib compression level, optional tEXt comments, HDR metadata, and optional gainmap plus its required metadata. fGainmap requires fGainmapInfo to be non-null for encoding to succeed.
Enumeration of WebP compression modes supported by this encoder: lossy or lossless.
Options controlling WebP encoding behavior, including compression mode and quality/effort level. fQuality is 0..100 and its interpretation depends on fCompression.
Enumeration of logical boolean operations for combining two SkPath values. Used by the path ops APIs in this header.

Helper/builder class that accumulates multiple SkPath operands with associated SkPathOp operations and resolves them into a single resulting SkPath. Internally stores added paths and their ops; resolve computes the combined result and resets the builder. Construction/destruction follow normal C++ rules; there are no special factory functions in this header.

Interface for remotable font management. Provides global instance management, font family matching, opening streams to font data, and constructing SkTypeface instances. Inherits from SkRefCnt for reference counting. Implementations must provide matchFamilyName and openStream; makeTypeface has a default implementation that uses openStream and a provided SkFontMgr. Lifetime is managed via sk_sp and RefGlobal/SetGlobal. GetSingletonDirectInterface returns a singleton implementation backed by libfontconfig (no refcount increment).

Opaque-identifying information for a font, intended as a union of storage types for implementations. Holds an ID, TTC index, auxiliary string (e.g., file path or unique key), and style. Provides equality operators and helper methods to serialize/deserialize to/from memory. Callers should not rely on semantic meaning of fields beyond using them to query/open fonts through the interface.

objects.definition: class SkFontMgr;
objects.description: Forward declaration of SkFontMgr, a Skia font manager abstraction. Only a forward declaration is present in this header; the full definition is elsewhere.

Public API class that creates a SkCanvas which serializes draw calls into SVG written to a provided SkWStream. Provides configuration via Flags, a PNG encoding callback, and an Options struct. Construction is via static Make factory functions; lifetime of the provided SkWStream must outlive the canvas.
Bitmask flags controlling SVG emission behavior: convert text to paths, disable pretty-printing, and use relative path commands. Used inside SkSVGCanvas and SkSVGCanvas::Options.

objects.definition: using EncodePngCallback = bool (*)(SkWStream* dst, const SkPixmap& src);
objects.description: Function pointer type for PNG encoding callbacks used by SkSVGCanvas when embedding raster data into SVG output. Returns true on successful encode to the provided SkWStream. The SkWStream and SkPixmap types are forward-declared elsewhere and must be valid at call time.

Configuration struct for SkSVGCanvas construction: holds bitmask Flags and an optional PNG encoding callback. Defaults to no flags and no encoder; behavior may be auto-filled in legacy builds as noted.

Abstract reference-counted interface for emitting a human-readable dump of a shader debug trace. Inherits from SkRefCnt, indicating lifetime is managed via reference counting. The only API is a pure virtual dump method that writes the trace to an SkWStream. Implementations must provide dump; this header does not provide constructors or factory functions.

Strongly-typed enumeration of SkSL shader language versions. k100 corresponds to Desktop GLSL 1.10 / GLSL ES 1.00 / WebGL 1.0; k300 corresponds to Desktop GLSL 3.30 / GLSL ES 3.00 / WebGL 2.0. No additional API or storage is defined in this header.
Enumeration of the possible 3D backend APIs available to Graphite. Values include Dawn, Metal, Vulkan, a mock backend for testing, and an Unsupported sentinel for unhandled context types.
Boolean-like enum indicating whether an allocation should count against the GPU cache budget.
Boolean-like enum returned to callback clients indicating failure or success of an operation associated with the callback.
Boolean-like enum indicating whether a texture is mipmapped.
Boolean-like enum indicating whether the GPU data/resource is protected (e.g., content protection).
Boolean-like enum indicating whether a texture can be used as a render target.
Enumeration of logical origin for textures or backend textures (top-left vs bottom-left).
Bitmask flags specifying which GPU statistics are being requested or reported. Currently supports an elapsed-time measurement flag.
Container for GPU statistic readings. Currently provides an elapsedTime field (nanoseconds unless documented otherwise by the caller).

Abstract base class in namespace skgpu for reporting shader compilation errors. It provides two overloads of compileError: a legacy two-argument version and a three-argument version that indicates whether the shader was cached; by default the latter forwards to the former. Copying is disabled. Derive from this class to intercept shader compile failures; override at least one compileError overload. The free function DefaultShaderErrorHandler() returns a process-wide default handler that logs via SkDebugf and asserts. Destruction and ownership are user-managed; no factory or reference counting is defined here.

Enumeration of GPU backends supported by Ganesh (Skia's GPU engine). Aliased to legacy GrBackend. Constants kMetal_GrBackend, kVulkan_GrBackend, kMock_GrBackend are constexpr values of this enum (not separate types).
Specifies whether a GPU surface’s (0,0) is at the top-left or bottom-left in texture space.
Bitmask flags for tracking parts of GL backend state that may be invalidated in a GrContext cache.

objects.definition: typedef void* GrGpuFinishedContext;
objects.description: Opaque context pointer type passed to GrGpuFinishedProc/GrGpuFinishedWithStatsProc callbacks.

objects.definition: typedef void (*GrGpuFinishedProc)(GrGpuFinishedContext finishedContext);
objects.description: Callback type invoked when all GPU work through a flush completes or immediately if flush work is not submitted.

objects.definition:
typedef void (*GrGpuFinishedWithStatsProc)(GrGpuFinishedContext finishedContext,
                                           const skgpu::GpuStats&);
objects.description: Callback type like GrGpuFinishedProc that also receives GpuStats; preferred when both are supplied.

objects.definition: typedef void* GrGpuSubmittedContext;
objects.description: Opaque context pointer passed to GrGpuSubmittedProc callback.

objects.definition: typedef void (*GrGpuSubmittedProc)(GrGpuSubmittedContext submittedContext, bool success);
objects.description: Callback type invoked when work from a flush is submitted to the GPU; success indicates submission result.

objects.definition: typedef void* GrDirectContextDestroyedContext;
objects.description: Opaque context pointer passed to GrDirectContextDestroyedProc callback.

objects.definition: typedef void (*GrDirectContextDestroyedProc)(GrDirectContextDestroyedContext destroyedContext);
objects.description: Callback type invoked when a GrDirectContext is destroyed.

Parameters for flush operations: number of semaphores to signal, optional stats flags, optional completion and submission callbacks and their opaque contexts, and an array of GrBackendSemaphore to signal. Note: GrBackendSemaphore is forward-declared here (not defined in this header).
Indicates whether valid semaphores from a flush will be submitted on the next submit call.
Options controlling resource purging: purge all resources or only scratch resources.
Whether to block CPU until submitted GPU work finishes.
Whether to mark a frame boundary during submission.
Options for submit behavior: CPU sync preference, frame boundary marker, and an optional frame ID.

Opaque lightweight value-type wrapper that describes a GPU backend pixel format plus texture type. It can represent formats for various backends (Mock and optionally Direct3D in this header). Holds small, type-erased backend-specific data and exposes queries like channel mask and color/compression types. Construction is via default/Copy or static factory helpers; validity is tracked with isValid().

Opaque handle to a GPU texture owned by the client and described to Skia. Stores dimensions, label, mipmap state, backend API, texture type, and backend-specific type-erased data. Provides queries, format retrieval, mutable-state updates, and equality tests. Validity is tracked via isValid().

Opaque handle describing a client-provided GPU renderable surface (render target). Stores size, sample count, stencil bits, backend API, framebuffer-only flag, and backend-specific type-erased data. Supports format retrieval, mutable-state updates, and validity checks.

objects.definition: class GrBackendSemaphoreData;
objects.description: Forward declaration of an internal base class that holds backend-specific semaphore data for GrBackendSemaphore. Only an incomplete type is present here; definition is elsewhere.

Public wrapper used by Skia Ganesh to pass backend semaphore synchronization primitives across API boundaries. It stores API-specific semaphore payload in an internal type-erased holder and tracks which backend (GrBackendApi) it targets. It is unusable until initialized via an init* method (currently only Direct3D is exposed under SK_DIRECT3D). Copyable/movable per the declared copy constructor/assignment; destruction/cleanup is handled internally by the library. Backend-specific getters/setters are conditionally available. Details of internal storage are largely opaque to users.

Top-level configuration struct for Skia Ganesh GPU context behavior and workarounds. Contains nested enums for feature toggles and shader cache strategies, and a nested abstract cache class. Fields tune caching, shader handling, GL/Vulkan behavior, glyph rendering, testing options, and various driver workarounds.
Tri-state toggle used by GrContextOptions to force-enable, force-disable, or defer to default behavior for specific features.
Specifies what representation to cache for shaders when using a PersistentCache: SkSL source, backend source (e.g., GLSL), or backend binaries (e.g., GL program binaries).

Abstract persistence interface for caching Skia data across runs (primarily compiled shader binaries). Implementations must provide load(); transitioning to 3-arg store() with description. Copying is disabled.
Type alias within GrContextOptions for skgpu::ShaderErrorHandler. This header only references the external type; its definition is not present here.

Primary GPU-backed Skia Ganesh recording context for direct, immediate rendering and GPU resource management. Provides creation and management of backend textures, flushing/submission, cache control, synchronization, and device-lost/abandon handling. Constructed via static Make* factory functions; destroyed via ref-counting (sk_sp). Must not be used after abandon or releaseResourcesAndAbandonContext. Many APIs require a later submit to send work to the GPU.
Lightweight identifier type for a GrDirectContext instance. Supports validity checks, equality, and generating a new ID via Next(). Used to tag and compare contexts.

objects.definition: using ReleaseContext = void*;
objects.description: Opaque caller-provided context pointer passed to release procs in SkSurfaces. It may be nullptr.

objects.definition: using RenderTargetReleaseProc = void (*)(ReleaseContext);
objects.description: Function pointer type for a user callback invoked when a wrapped backend render target can be released. The callback receives the associated ReleaseContext.

objects.definition: using TextureReleaseProc = void (*)(ReleaseContext);
