objects.description: Function pointer type for a user callback invoked when a wrapped backend texture can be released. The callback receives the associated ReleaseContext.

objects.definition: using BackendHandleAccess = SkSurface::BackendHandleAccess;
objects.description: Alias to SkSurface::BackendHandleAccess specifying how backend handles are accessed when retrieving GPU resources from a SkSurface. Note: underlying enum/class is defined elsewhere; this is just a type alias here.
Alias for a callable type used as a release callback when a GrBackendTexture obtained from an SkImage can be released. The callable takes a GrBackendTexture by value and returns void.
C function pointer type for a user-provided callback invoked when a borrowed GPU texture may be released. The callback receives a ReleaseContext (opaque pointer defined by the Skia GPU API).
Strongly-typed status wrapper (temporary shim around an enum) returned by insertRecording to communicate success or specific failure reasons; implicitly convertible to bool where true means kSuccess.
Parameter bundle used when inserting a Recording into a Context: target surface/transform/clip, semaphores to wait/signal, completion callbacks, optional GPU stats, and a test-only simulated status.
Compact set of completion callback and optional stats flags for tracking when an inserted Recording finishes on the GPU.
Controls whether submit should block until GPU work completes and synchronize results back to the CPU.
Marks a submission as a frame boundary and optionally carries a frame ID for tracking.
Parameters controlling GPU submission behavior: whether to sync to CPU, whether this marks a frame boundary, and an optional frame ID.
Indicates whether a Promise Image must be fulfilled once or on every insertion of a Recording that references it.
Bitmask flags selecting presence of depth and/or stencil attachments.
Strongly-typed MSAA sample count wrapper with limited valid values (1,2,4,8,16) and comparison/cast helpers; replaces raw integer usage.

objects.definition:
enum DrawTypeFlags : uint16_t {

    kNone             = 0,

    kBitmapText_Mask  = 1 << 0,
    kBitmapText_LCD   = 1 << 1,
    kBitmapText_Color = 1 << 2,
    kSDFText          = 1 << 3,
    kSDFText_LCD      = 1 << 4,

    kDrawVertices     = 1 << 5,

    kCircularArc      = 1 << 6,

    kAnalyticRRect    = 1 << 7,
    kPerEdgeAAQuad    = 1 << 8,
    kNonAAFillRect    = 1 << 9,

    kSimpleShape      = kAnalyticRRect | kPerEdgeAAQuad | kNonAAFillRect,

    kNonSimpleShape   = 1 << 10,

    kDropShadows      = 1 << 11,

    kAnalyticClip     = 1 << 12,

    kLast = kAnalyticClip,
};
objects.description: Bitflag enum mapping observed RenderSteps to precompilation draw-type categories used by the Graphite pipeline precompilation API.

objects.definition: using GpuFinishedContext = void*;
objects.description: Opaque client-provided context pointer passed back to GPU-finished callbacks.

objects.definition: using GpuFinishedProc = void (*)(GpuFinishedContext finishedContext, CallbackResult);
objects.description: Callback function pointer invoked when a Recording finishes or fails; receives the client context and a CallbackResult.
Callback function pointer variant that also receives GPU execution statistics when requested and successful.

Graphite GPU Context encapsulating backend device state, resource management, async readback utilities, submission, cleanup, and capture/sync features. Non-copyable and provides factory methods for Recorder and PrecompileContext. Owns/manages SharedContext, QueueManager, ResourceProvider, ClientMappedBufferManager, and CPU context handles.
Lightweight identifier for a Context instance. Default-constructs invalid; can be compared, invalidated, and queried. IDs are generated via static Next().

Public configuration object for a skgpu::graphite::Recorder. Holds client-specified knobs such as an ImageProvider, GPU memory budget, and whether recordings are assumed to be replayed in order. Also exposes a private testing hook via RecorderOptionsPriv. Constructors and destructor are declared here and defined elsewhere.

Graphite recording object that derives from SkRecorder. It records GPU work, manages transient GPU resources and uploads, and can produce a Recording via snap() for submission to a Context. It also exposes helpers to create/update/delete BackendTexture objects and manage memory budgets. Lifetime is controlled externally; copy/move is disabled.

Final public class representing a recorded sequence of GPU work for Skia Graphite. It owns task lists, resource references, and lazy target proxy data. Constructor is private (friend of Recorder), so users typically obtain Recordings via a Recorder. Provides a destructor and a priv() accessor for internal/private utilities. Fields indicate it aggregates TaskList and holds extra resource refs and lazy proxies for textures. Construction/destruction details beyond this header are not provided.

objects.definition: using ReleaseContext = void*;
objects.description: Opaque pointer type used as the user-provided context passed to a TextureReleaseProc callback in the SkSurfaces namespace. It carries no ownership semantics by itself; lifetime and meaning are defined by the client.

objects.definition: using TextureReleaseProc = void (*)(ReleaseContext);
objects.description: Function pointer type for a callback invoked to release a wrapped backend texture’s resources. Receives the user-provided ReleaseContext. Implementations should perform any cleanup needed for externally owned GPU objects. Called by Skia according to the wrap’s lifetime semantics.

objects.definition: enum class GenerateMipmapsFromBase : bool { kNo, kYes };
objects.description: Enum flag in the SkImages namespace indicating whether mipmaps should be generated from the base level when wrapping a texture. Stored as a bool-sized enum.

objects.definition: using TextureReleaseProc = void (*)(ReleaseContext);
objects.description: Function pointer typedef for a callback invoked when backend texture resources can be released. Takes a ReleaseContext argument (defined elsewhere).

objects.definition: using GraphitePromiseImageContext = void*;
objects.description: Opaque pointer typedef representing user-provided image-level context passed to fulfill/imageRelease callbacks for Graphite promise images.

objects.definition: using GraphitePromiseTextureFulfillContext = void*;
objects.description: Opaque pointer typedef representing per-texture fulfill context passed to the fulfill proc for Graphite promise images. For non-YUVA images, the image context is reused as the fulfill context; YUVA images may have per-plane contexts.

objects.definition: using GraphitePromiseTextureReleaseContext = void*;
objects.description: Opaque pointer typedef returned by the fulfill proc and later passed to the textureRelease proc to release per-texture resources for Graphite promise images.

Function pointer typedef for the fulfill callback used by Graphite promise images. It is called to supply a valid BackendTexture and an associated release context for later textureRelease. Takes a fulfill context and returns a tuple of BackendTexture and GraphitePromiseTextureReleaseContext.

objects.definition: using GraphitePromiseImageReleaseProc = void (*)(GraphitePromiseImageContext);
objects.description: Function pointer typedef for the image-level release callback used by Graphite promise images. Called once when Skia will no longer attempt to fulfill the image.

objects.definition: using GraphitePromiseTextureReleaseProc = void (*)(GraphitePromiseTextureReleaseContext);
objects.description: Function pointer typedef for the per-texture release callback used by Graphite promise images. Called once the GPU is done with the supplied BackendTexture.

functions.name: SkColorSetARGB
functions.signature: static constexpr inline SkColor SkColorSetARGB(U8CPU a, U8CPU r, U8CPU g, U8CPU b)
functions.description: Constructs an unpremultiplied 32-bit ARGB color from 8-bit channel values. Intended for creating SkColor constants/values directly from byte components.
requirements: a, r, g, b are treated as 8-bit values; in debug builds the function asserts that each <= 255.
Returns an unpremultiplied color; r,g,b need not be <= a.

functions.name: SkColorSetRGB
functions.signature: SkColor SkColorSetRGB(U8CPU r, U8CPU g, U8CPU b)
functions.description: Macro that constructs an unpremultiplied 32-bit ARGB SkColor with alpha set to 255 (fully opaque) from 8-bit red, green, and blue components. Expands to SkColorSetARGB(0xFF, r, g, b). Use when you need an opaque color constant or to build colors for SkPaint and similar APIs.
requirements: r, g, and b must be in the range [0, 255]. In debug builds, values outside this range trigger an assertion in SkColorSetARGB.
Inputs should be values convertible to U8CPU (8-bit channel semantics).

functions.name: SkColorGetA
functions.description: Macro that extracts the 8-bit alpha component from an unpremultiplied 32-bit ARGB SkColor by shifting and masking. Returns a value 0..255.
requirements: color must be a valid SkColor (32-bit ARGB as produced by SkColorSetARGB/SkColorSetRGB or equivalent packed value).

functions.name: SkColorGetR
functions.description: Macro that extracts the 8-bit red component from an unpremultiplied 32-bit ARGB SkColor by shifting and masking. Returns a value 0..255.
requirements: color must be a valid SkColor (32-bit ARGB).

functions.name: SkColorGetG
functions.description: Macro that extracts the 8-bit green component from an unpremultiplied 32-bit ARGB SkColor by shifting and masking. Returns a value 0..255.
requirements: color must be a valid SkColor (32-bit ARGB).

functions.name: SkColorGetB
functions.description: Macro that extracts the 8-bit blue component from an unpremultiplied 32-bit ARGB SkColor by shifting and masking. Returns a value 0..255.
requirements: color must be a valid SkColor (32-bit ARGB).

functions.name: SkColorSetA
functions.signature: [[nodiscard]] static constexpr inline SkColor SkColorSetA(SkColor c, U8CPU a)
functions.description: Returns a copy of color c with its alpha component replaced by a (unpremultiplied ARGB).
requirements: a is treated as 8-bit; in debug builds the implementation asserts a <= 255 when used via SkColorSetARGB.
c is an unpremultiplied SkColor (0xAARRGGBB).

functions.name: SkRGBToHSV
functions.signature: SK_API void SkRGBToHSV(U8CPU red, U8CPU green, U8CPU blue, SkScalar hsv[3])
functions.description: Converts 8-bit RGB components to HSV. Writes hue (degrees in [0,360)), saturation [0,1], and value [0,1] into hsv[0..2].
requirements: red, green, blue are bytes in the range [0,255].
hsv must point to writable storage for at least 3 SkScalar values.

functions.name: SkColorToHSV
functions.signature: static inline void SkColorToHSV(SkColor color, SkScalar hsv[3])
functions.description: Converts an ARGB SkColor to HSV. Alpha is ignored; hue, saturation, value are written to hsv[0..2].
requirements: color is an unpremultiplied SkColor (0xAARRGGBB).
hsv must point to writable storage for at least 3 SkScalar values.

functions.name: SkHSVToColor
functions.signature: SK_API SkColor SkHSVToColor(U8CPU alpha, const SkScalar hsv[3])
functions.description: Converts HSV to an unpremultiplied ARGB SkColor, using the supplied alpha. Out-of-range HSV inputs are pinned to valid ranges.
requirements: hsv must point to at least 3 readable SkScalar values (hue, saturation, value).
alpha is treated as 8-bit; values >255 are invalid and may assert in debug.

functions.name: SkPreMultiplyARGB
functions.signature: SK_API SkPMColor SkPreMultiplyARGB(U8CPU a, U8CPU r, U8CPU g, U8CPU b)
functions.description: Builds a premultiplied-color SkPMColor from unpremultiplied 8-bit ARGB components (multiplies RGB by alpha and packs in N32/bgra layout).
requirements: a, r, g, b are 8-bit channel values in [0,255].

functions.name: SkPreMultiplyColor
functions.description: Converts an unpremultiplied SkColor (0xAARRGGBB) to the closest premultiplied SkPMColor in the native N32 format.
requirements: c is an unpremultiplied SkColor.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType>::FromColor
functions.description: Creates an unpremultiplied float RGBA color from a SkColor (A8R8G8B8). This is the FromColor specialization usable for kUnpremul colors (aka SkColor4f).
requirements: color is an unpremultiplied SkColor (0xAARRGGBB).

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType>::toSkColor
functions.description: Converts an unpremultiplied SkRGBA4f to the closest 8-bit per channel SkColor (A8R8G8B8).
requirements: All channels ideally in [0,1] for accurate conversion; the class provides fitsInBytes() to check this. Out-of-range handling is unspecified in this header.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType>::premul
functions.description: Returns a premultiplied copy of this unpremultiplied color by multiplying RGB by alpha and keeping alpha unchanged.
requirements: Only available for kUnpremul instantiation; enforced by compile-time static_assert.
If alpha is outside [0,1], behavior is not defined here; typically values are expected in [0,1].

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kPremul_SkAlphaType>::unpremul
functions.description: Returns an unpremultiplied copy of this premultiplied color by dividing RGB by alpha. If alpha is 0, returns zeros.
requirements: Only available for kPremul instantiation; enforced by compile-time static_assert.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType>::toBytes_RGBA
functions.description: Packs this float RGBA color into a 32-bit value in RGBA byte order. Specialization exists for SkColor4f.
requirements: Color channels ideally in [0,1] for meaningful packing; class offers fitsInBytes() check.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType>::FromBytes_RGBA
functions.description: Creates an unpremultiplied float RGBA color from a 32-bit RGBA-ordered packed color value. Specialization exists for SkColor4f.
requirements: color is packed as 0xRRGGBAA (RGBA byte order).

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType>::makeOpaque
functions.description: Returns a copy of this color with alpha forced to 1.0.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType>::pinAlpha
functions.description: Returns a copy with alpha clamped to the range [0,1].

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType>::withAlpha
functions.description: Returns a copy of this color with alpha replaced by a.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType>::withAlphaByte
functions.description: Returns a copy of this color with alpha replaced by a/255.0f.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::vec
functions.signature: template <SkAlphaType kAT> const float* SkRGBA4f<kAT>::vec() const
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal [R,G,B,A] float array (const).
requirements: The returned pointer remains valid as long as the SkRGBA4f object exists and is not modified in a way that relocates it (it points to object storage).
Do not write through this pointer.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::array
functions.description: Returns a std::array copy of the color components in [R,G,B,A] order.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator==
functions.signature: template <SkAlphaType kAT> bool SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator==(const SkRGBA4f<kAT>& other) const
functions.description: Component-wise equality comparison of two SkRGBA4f values.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator!=
functions.signature: template <SkAlphaType kAT> bool SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator!=(const SkRGBA4f<kAT>& other) const
functions.description: Logical negation of operator==; returns true if any component differs.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator*
functions.signature: template <SkAlphaType kAT> SkRGBA4f<kAT> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator*(float scale) const
functions.description: Scales all components (R,G,B,A) by the scalar factor scale.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator[]
functions.signature: template <SkAlphaType kAT> float SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator[](int index) const
functions.description: Indexed read access to components; index 0..3 correspond to R,G,B,A. Asserts in debug if out of range.
requirements: index must be in [0,3].

functions.name: SkColor4f::FromColor
functions.description: Explicit specialization that converts an unpremultiplied SkColor (A8R8G8B8) to SkColor4f (unpremultiplied float RGBA).
requirements: color is an unpremultiplied SkColor (0xAARRGGBB).

functions.name: SkColor4f::toSkColor
functions.description: Explicit specialization that converts SkColor4f (float RGBA, unpremultiplied) to the closest 8-bit SkColor (A8R8G8B8).
requirements: Channels ideally in [0,1] for accurate conversion; out-of-range handling is unspecified here.

functions.name: SkColor4f::toBytes_RGBA
functions.description: Explicit specialization that packs SkColor4f into a 32-bit value in RGBA byte order.
requirements: Channels ideally in [0,1] for meaningful packing.

functions.name: SkColor4f::FromBytes_RGBA
functions.description: Explicit specialization that creates a SkColor4f from a 32-bit RGBA-ordered packed color.
requirements: color is packed in RGBA byte order (0xRRGGBAA).

functions.name: SkAlphaTypeIsOpaque
functions.description: Returns true if the provided SkAlphaType equals kOpaque_SkAlphaType, indicating pixels are treated as fully opaque. Typically used to branch to fast paths that can ignore alpha. Note: In the broader API, if SkAlphaType is kOpaque_SkAlphaType but the associated SkColorType is not opaque, drawing pixels with alpha < 1.0 is documented as undefined; this is a usage note about the surrounding graphics pipeline, not this function itself.
requirements: Parameter at must be a valid SkAlphaType enumeration value (e.g., kUnknown_SkAlphaType, kOpaque_SkAlphaType, kPremul_SkAlphaType, or kUnpremul_SkAlphaType).
No side effects; may be called at any time with any enum value; returns a boolean indicating opacity status.

functions.name: SkBlendMode_AsCoeff
functions.signature: bool SkBlendMode_AsCoeff(SkBlendMode mode, SkBlendModeCoeff* src, SkBlendModeCoeff* dst);
functions.description: Determine whether a blend mode is a coefficient-based Porter–Duff mode (mode <= kLastCoeffMode). If true is returned, the function writes the mode’s source and destination coefficient selectors into *src and *dst, which describe the equation: (dstCoeff * dst + srcCoeff * src). Use this to quickly map a Porter–Duff mode to its coefficient pair.
requirements: mode should be a valid SkBlendMode value (typically 0..SkBlendMode::kLastMode).
If the function returns true, the caller must provide writable, non-null pointers for src and dst to receive the coefficients.
If the function returns false, outputs are not set; caller must not assume src/dst are written.
The exact behavior when passing null for src or dst is not documented; treat as invalid usage.

functions.name: SkRRect::inset
functions.signature: void SkRRect::inset(SkScalar dx, SkScalar dy, SkRRect* dst) const;
functions.description: Copies this into dst, then insets bounds by (dx, dy) and adjusts radii accordingly. Radii are clamped at zero when they would go negative; corners with zero radius remain unchanged.
requirements: dst must be a valid, non-null pointer (may alias this).
dx and dy may be positive, negative, or zero.
If |dx| >= width/2 or |dy| >= height/2, the corresponding bounds edges collapse to the center.
If the operation produces infinite bounds, dst bounds are zeroed.

functions.name: SkRRect::inset
functions.description: Insets this SkRRect in place by (dx, dy) and adjusts corner radii as in the three-argument inset.
requirements: dx and dy may be positive, negative, or zero.
If |dx| >= width/2 or |dy| >= height/2, the corresponding bounds edges collapse to the center.
If the operation produces infinite bounds, bounds are zeroed.

functions.description: Copies this into dst, then outsets bounds by (dx, dy) and adjusts radii accordingly (equivalent to inset with -dx, -dy).
requirements: dst must be a valid, non-null pointer (may alias this).
dx and dy may be positive, negative, or zero.
If the operation produces infinite bounds, dst bounds are zeroed.

functions.name: SkRRect::outset
functions.description: Outsets this SkRRect in place by (dx, dy) and adjusts corner radii (equivalent to inset with -dx, -dy).
requirements: dx and dy may be positive, negative, or zero.
If the operation produces infinite bounds, bounds are zeroed.

functions.name: SkRRect::isValid

functions.name: SkRRect::writeToMemory
functions.description: Serializes this SkRRect into the provided buffer. Writes exactly kSizeInMemory bytes and returns that size.
requirements: buffer must point to writable memory of at least kSizeInMemory bytes.
Serialization format is exactly kSizeInMemory (= 12 * sizeof(SkScalar)) bytes.

functions.name: SkRRect::readFromMemory

functions.description: Deserializes this SkRRect from the provided buffer. Reads kSizeInMemory bytes if length >= kSizeInMemory and returns kSizeInMemory; otherwise returns 0 and leaves the object unspecified.

functions.name: SkPathEffect::filterPath
functions.signature: bool filterPath(SkPathBuilder* dst, const SkPath& src, SkStrokeRec*, const SkRect* cullR, const SkMatrix& ctm) const;
functions.description: Applies this path effect to the source path. On success, writes the transformed path into dst and may modify the provided SkStrokeRec (e.g., change stroke width/join or convert between stroke and fill). If the effect cannot be applied, returns false and the caller must ignore dst and the stroke-rec changes. This overload is used when a current transform matrix (CTM) is available.
requirements: dst must be a valid, non-null SkPathBuilder pointer ready to receive the result (inferred from pointer parameter)
src must be a valid SkPath
The SkStrokeRec pointer must be valid and initialized; it is both input and output and may be modified by the effect (explicit in comments)
cullR may be null or a valid pointer to a SkRect used for culling (inferred from pointer-to-const that is allowed to be null by comment context)
ctm must be a valid SkMatrix representing the current transform matrix (inferred from parameter purpose)
If the function returns false, the caller must ignore dst and SkStrokeRec (explicit in comments)
If the function returns true, the caller is responsible for applying the resulting SkStrokeRec to dst before drawing, as needed (explicit in comments)

functions.name: SkPathEffect::filterPath

functions.description: Applies this path effect to the source path without an explicit CTM. On success, writes the transformed path into dst and may modify the SkStrokeRec; on failure returns false and the caller must ignore dst and the stroke-rec changes.
requirements: dst must be a valid, non-null SkPathBuilder pointer (inferred from pointer parameter)
src must be a valid SkPath
The SkStrokeRec pointer must be valid and initialized; it is both input and output and may be modified by the effect (explicit in comments)
If the function returns false, the caller must ignore dst and SkStrokeRec (explicit in comments)
If the function returns true, the caller is responsible for applying the resulting SkStrokeRec to dst before drawing, as needed (explicit in comments)

functions.name: SkCubicResampler::Mitchell
functions.description: Returns a SkCubicResampler configured with B=1/3 and C=1/3 (the Mitchell filter). Use when you want bicubic reconstruction with Mitchell parameters.

functions.name: SkCubicResampler::CatmullRom
functions.description: Returns a SkCubicResampler configured with B=0 and C=1/2 (the Catmull–Rom filter). Use when you want bicubic reconstruction with Catmull–Rom parameters.

functions.name: SkSamplingOptions::SkSamplingOptions
functions.description: Default-constructs sampling options: nearest filter, no mipmaps, no anisotropy, no cubic resampler.

functions.name: SkSamplingOptions::SkSamplingOptions
functions.description: Copy-constructs a SkSamplingOptions from another instance. Copies all sampling state (filter, mipmap, cubic parameters, anisotropy flag).
requirements: Source instance must be a valid, initialized SkSamplingOptions.

functions.name: SkSamplingOptions::SkSamplingOptions
functions.description: Constructs sampling options with explicit filter and mipmap modes.
requirements: fm must be a valid SkFilterMode enum value.
mm must be a valid SkMipmapMode enum value.

functions.name: SkSamplingOptions::SkSamplingOptions
functions.description: Constructs sampling options with an explicit filter mode and no mipmaps (mipmap mode set to kNone).
requirements: fm must be a valid SkFilterMode enum value.

functions.name: SkSamplingOptions::operator=
functions.description: Assigns this instance from another, using a self-destruct and placement-new copy of the source state.
requirements: The source argument must be a valid, initialized SkSamplingOptions.
Self-assignment is not allowed; passing the same object as both source and destination leads to undefined behavior due to explicit destruction before copy.

functions.name: SkSamplingOptions::Aniso
functions.description: Factory that returns sampling options configured for anisotropic filtering. The provided maxAniso is clamped to at least 1.
requirements: maxAniso may be any integer; values <= 0 will be treated as 1.

functions.name: SkSamplingOptions::operator==
functions.description: Compares two SkSamplingOptions for exact equality of anisotropy, cubic usage and parameters, and filter/mipmap modes.
requirements: Both operands must be valid, initialized SkSamplingOptions.

functions.name: SkSamplingOptions::operator!=
functions.description: Returns the logical negation of operator== comparison for SkSamplingOptions.
requirements: Both operands must be valid, initialized SkSamplingOptions.

functions.name: SkSamplingOptions::isAniso
functions.description: Returns true if anisotropic filtering is enabled (maxAniso != 0).
requirements: The object must be a valid, initialized SkSamplingOptions.

functions.name: SkColorTypeBytesPerPixel
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to store one pixel of the specified SkColorType, including any padding. Returns 0 if the color type is kUnknown_SkColorType or otherwise invalid.
requirements: ct may be any SkColorType; if ct is kUnknown_SkColorType or invalid, the return is 0.
Callers should not assume non-zero unless ct is a known, supported SkColorType.

functions.name: SkColorTypeIsAlwaysOpaque
functions.description: Returns true if the specified SkColorType has no alpha channel and always decodes alpha to 1.0 (fully opaque).
requirements: ct may be any SkColorType; function returns whether the type is inherently opaque (no alpha bits).

functions.name: SkColorTypeValidateAlphaType
functions.signature: SK_API bool SkColorTypeValidateAlphaType(SkColorType colorType, SkAlphaType alphaType, SkAlphaType* canonical = nullptr);
functions.description: Validates that an SkAlphaType can be associated with a given SkColorType, and optionally returns a canonical alpha type for that color type. If multiple alpha types are valid, the provided alphaType is preferred when valid. Returns false only if alphaType is kUnknown_SkAlphaType while colorType is not kUnknown_SkColorType and the color type is not always opaque. If true and canonical is non-null, stores the valid canonical SkAlphaType to *canonical.
requirements: If the function returns true and canonical is not nullptr, caller must provide a writable pointer to store the canonical alpha type.
If the function returns false, canonical must be ignored by the caller (any output is unspecified).
colorType and alphaType need not be validated before calling; this routine performs the validation.

functions.name: SkYUVColorSpaceIsLimitedRange
functions.description: Returns true if the specified SkYUVColorSpace represents a limited-range encoding (e.g., video ranges like 16–235/240) rather than full range.
requirements: cs must be one of the defined SkYUVColorSpace enum values.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::SkColorInfo
functions.description: Default-constructs an SkColorInfo with kUnknown_SkColorType, kUnknown_SkAlphaType, and no SkColorSpace.
requirements: No arguments. Constructs an 'empty' color description.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::SkColorInfo
functions.signature: SkColorInfo::SkColorInfo(SkColorType ct, SkAlphaType at, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> cs);
functions.description: Constructs an SkColorInfo from a color type, alpha type, and optional color space. If cs is nullptr and this SkColorInfo is used as a drawing source, SkColorSpace defaults to sRGB when mapped into a destination surface. Parameters are not validated for legality or mutual support.
requirements: ct, at may be any values (not validated here).
cs may be nullptr; if nullptr and used as a source during drawing, sRGB behavior applies during mapping.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::SkColorInfo
functions.description: Copy constructor. Creates a new SkColorInfo that represents the same color type, alpha type, and color space as the source.
requirements: Source object must be a valid SkColorInfo.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::~SkColorInfo
functions.description: Destructor for SkColorInfo. Releases any owned references (e.g., SkColorSpace smart pointer).
requirements: Object must have been previously constructed. No special requirements for callers.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::operator=
functions.description: Copy assignment operator. Assigns this SkColorInfo to represent the same color type, alpha type, and color space as the source.
requirements: Source object must be a valid SkColorInfo.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::operator=
functions.description: Move assignment operator. Moves the color description and color space reference from another SkColorInfo into this one.
requirements: After assignment, the source object may be in a moved-from state.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::colorSpace
functions.description: Returns the associated SkColorSpace pointer without altering its reference count. The returned SkColorSpace is immutable and may be nullptr.
requirements: Caller must not modify or unref the returned pointer; it is owned elsewhere.
Returned pointer may be nullptr and must be null-checked before dereference.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::refColorSpace
functions.description: Returns a reference-counted smart pointer to the associated SkColorSpace. The returned SkColorSpace is immutable.
requirements: Caller receives a new smart-pointer reference and must manage it via sk_sp semantics (automatic on scope exit).
Returned smart pointer may hold nullptr and should be checked before use.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::colorType
functions.description: Returns the SkColorType of this color description.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::alphaType
functions.description: Returns the SkAlphaType of this color description.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::isOpaque
functions.description: Returns true if the alpha is effectively opaque, meaning either the alpha type is opaque or the color type is always opaque.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::gammaCloseToSRGB
functions.description: Returns true if the associated SkColorSpace is non-null and its transfer characteristics are approximately sRGB-like.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::operator==
functions.description: Returns true if this and other represent the same color type, alpha type, and color space.
requirements: 'other' must be a valid SkColorInfo.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::operator!=
functions.description: Returns true if this and other differ in color type, alpha type, or color space.
requirements: 'other' must be a valid SkColorInfo.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::makeAlphaType
functions.description: Returns a copy of this SkColorInfo with the alpha type set to newAlphaType. The result may contain an alpha type that is incompatible with the color type; in such cases, the alpha may be ignored by consumers.
requirements: newAlphaType may be any SkAlphaType, including values that may not be compatible with the current color type.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::makeColorType
functions.description: Returns a copy of this SkColorInfo with the color type set to newColorType.
requirements: newColorType may be any SkColorType; no validation is performed here.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::makeColorSpace
functions.description: Returns a copy of this SkColorInfo with the color space set to cs (which may be nullptr).
requirements: cs may be nullptr.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::bytesPerPixel
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes per pixel required by this color info’s color type. Returns 0 if the color type is kUnknown_SkColorType.

functions.name: SkColorInfo::shiftPerPixel
functions.description: Returns the bit shift used to convert between row bytes and row pixels for this color info’s color type. Returns 0 for kUnknown_SkColorType.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::SkImageInfo
functions.description: Default-constructs an empty SkImageInfo with kUnknown_SkColorType, kUnknown_SkAlphaType, zero width and height, and no SkColorSpace.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::Make
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::Make(int width, int height, SkColorType ct, SkAlphaType at);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo from integral width/height, color type, and alpha type. Color space is unspecified (may be treated as sRGB in some source contexts). Parameters are not validated.
requirements: width must be zero or greater.
height must be zero or greater.
ct and at are not validated for compatibility here.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::Make
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::Make(int width, int height, SkColorType ct, SkAlphaType at, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> cs);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo from width/height, color type, alpha type, and optional color space. If cs is nullptr and used as a drawing source, it defaults to sRGB when mapping into a surface. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: width must be zero or greater.
height must be zero or greater.
cs may be nullptr.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::Make
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::Make(SkISize dimensions, SkColorType ct, SkAlphaType at);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo from dimensions with a specified color type and alpha type. Color space is unspecified. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: dimensions width and height must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::Make
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::Make(SkISize dimensions, SkColorType ct, SkAlphaType at, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> cs);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo from dimensions, color type, alpha type, and optional color space. If cs is nullptr and used as a drawing source, defaults to sRGB when mapping into a surface. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: dimensions width and height must be zero or greater.
cs may be nullptr.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::Make
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::Make(SkISize dimensions, const SkColorInfo& colorInfo);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo from dimensions and an existing SkColorInfo. Inline wrapper around a private constructor.
requirements: dimensions width and height must be zero or greater.
colorInfo must describe the desired pixel encoding.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::Make
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::Make(SkISize dimensions, SkColorInfo&& colorInfo);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo from dimensions and a moved-in SkColorInfo. Inline wrapper around a private constructor.
requirements: dimensions width and height must be zero or greater.
After the call, the moved-from colorInfo may be in a valid but unspecified state.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeN32
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::MakeN32(int width, int height, SkAlphaType at);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kN32_SkColorType (either BGRA_8888 or RGBA_8888, whichever is optimal) for the given width/height and alpha type. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: width must be zero or greater.
height must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeN32
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::MakeN32(int width, int height, SkAlphaType at, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> cs);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kN32_SkColorType and the given alpha type and optional color space. If cs is nullptr and used as a drawing source, defaults to sRGB when mapping into a surface. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: width must be zero or greater.
height must be zero or greater.
cs may be nullptr.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeS32
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::MakeS32(int width, int height, SkAlphaType at);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kN32_SkColorType, the given alpha type, and an sRGB SkColorSpace. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: width must be zero or greater.
height must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul(int width, int height);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kN32_SkColorType and kPremul_SkAlphaType for the given width/height. If used as a drawing source, color space defaults to sRGB when mapping into a surface. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: width must be zero or greater.
height must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul(int width, int height, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> cs);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kN32_SkColorType, kPremul_SkAlphaType, and optional color space for the given width/height. If cs is nullptr and used as a drawing source, defaults to sRGB when mapping into a surface. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: width must be zero or greater.
height must be zero or greater.
cs may be nullptr.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kN32_SkColorType, kPremul_SkAlphaType, with nullptr color space, for the given dimensions. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: dimensions width and height must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul(SkISize dimensions, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> cs);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kN32_SkColorType, kPremul_SkAlphaType, and optional color space for the given dimensions. If cs is nullptr and used as a drawing source, defaults to sRGB when mapping into a surface. Parameters are not validated.
requirements: dimensions width and height must be zero or greater.
cs may be nullptr.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeA8
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::MakeA8(int width, int height);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kAlpha_8_SkColorType and kPremul_SkAlphaType for the given width/height, with nullptr color space.
requirements: width must be zero or greater.
height must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeA8
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kAlpha_8_SkColorType and kPremul_SkAlphaType for the given dimensions, with nullptr color space.
requirements: dimensions width and height must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeUnknown
functions.signature: static SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::MakeUnknown(int width, int height);
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with kUnknown_SkColorType and kUnknown_SkAlphaType for the specified width/height, with nullptr color space. Such an SkImageInfo as a source does not draw, and as a destination cannot be drawn to.
requirements: width must be zero or greater.
height must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::MakeUnknown
functions.description: Creates an SkImageInfo with width and height set to zero, kUnknown_SkColorType, and kUnknown_SkAlphaType, with nullptr color space. Such an SkImageInfo as a source does not draw, and as a destination cannot be drawn to.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::width
functions.description: Returns the pixel width (number of columns).

functions.name: SkImageInfo::height
functions.description: Returns the pixel height (number of rows).

functions.name: SkImageInfo::colorType
functions.description: Returns the SkColorType of the image.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::alphaType
functions.description: Returns the SkAlphaType of the image.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::colorSpace
functions.description: Returns the associated SkColorSpace pointer without altering its reference count. The returned SkColorSpace is immutable and may be nullptr.
requirements: Caller must not modify or unref the returned pointer; it is owned elsewhere.
Returned pointer may be nullptr and must be checked before dereference.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::refColorSpace
functions.description: Returns a reference-counted smart pointer to the associated SkColorSpace. The returned SkColorSpace is immutable.
requirements: Caller receives and manages an sk_sp reference (automatic).
Pointer may be nullptr; check before use.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::isEmpty
functions.description: Returns true if either width or height is zero or negative, indicating an empty pixel area.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::colorInfo
functions.description: Returns a dimensionless SkColorInfo describing the same color type, alpha type, and color space as this SkImageInfo.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid as long as the SkImageInfo remains alive.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::isOpaque
functions.description: Returns true if the image’s alpha is effectively opaque (either alpha type is opaque or the color type is always opaque).

functions.name: SkImageInfo::dimensions
functions.description: Returns an SkISize consisting of { width(), height() }.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::bounds
functions.description: Returns an SkIRect from origin to the image’s width and height: {0,0,width(),height()}.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::gammaCloseToSRGB
functions.description: Returns true if the associated SkColorSpace is non-null and its gamma is approximately sRGB.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::makeWH
functions.signature: SkImageInfo SkImageInfo::makeWH(int newWidth, int newHeight) const;
functions.description: Returns a copy of this SkImageInfo with dimensions set to newWidth and newHeight, preserving color type, alpha type, and color space.
requirements: newWidth must be zero or greater.
newHeight must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::makeDimensions
functions.description: Returns a copy of this SkImageInfo with dimensions set to newSize, preserving color type, alpha type, and color space.
requirements: newSize width and height must be zero or greater.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::makeAlphaType
functions.description: Returns a copy of this SkImageInfo with the alpha type set to newAlphaType. The result may contain an alpha type incompatible with the color type; in such cases, the alpha may be ignored by consumers.
requirements: newAlphaType may be any SkAlphaType.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::makeColorType
functions.description: Returns a copy of this SkImageInfo with the color type set to newColorType.
requirements: newColorType may be any SkColorType.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::makeColorSpace
functions.description: Returns a copy of this SkImageInfo with the color space set to cs. cs may be nullptr.
requirements: cs may be nullptr.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::bytesPerPixel
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes per pixel for this image’s color type. Returns 0 if the color type is kUnknown_SkColorType.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::shiftPerPixel
functions.description: Returns the bit shift used to convert between row bytes and row pixels for this image’s color type. Returns 0 for kUnknown_SkColorType.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::minRowBytes64
functions.description: Returns the minimum number of bytes per row as a 64-bit value, computed as width() * bytesPerPixel().

functions.name: SkImageInfo::minRowBytes
functions.description: Returns the minimum number of bytes per row as size_t, or 0 if the required value does not fit in 31 bits (SkBitmap row-bytes limit).

functions.name: SkImageInfo::computeOffset
functions.signature: size_t SkImageInfo::computeOffset(int x, int y, size_t rowBytes) const;
functions.description: Returns the byte offset of pixel (x,y) from the base address given the supplied rowBytes. Asserts in debug builds if x or y are out of bounds. Does not assert if rowBytes < minRowBytes(), even though the result may be incorrect.
requirements: x must be in [0, width()).
y must be in [0, height()).
rowBytes should be at least minRowBytes(); otherwise, the computed offset may be invalid.
In debug builds, out-of-bounds x or y will trigger an assertion.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::operator==
functions.description: Returns true if width, height, color type, alpha type, and color space are all equal to those of other.
requirements: 'other' must be a valid SkImageInfo.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::operator!=
functions.description: Returns true if any of width, height, color type, alpha type, or color space differ from those of other.
requirements: 'other' must be a valid SkImageInfo.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::computeByteSize
functions.description: Returns the total storage required for the pixel array given rowBytes. Returns 0 if height is 0. Returns SIZE_MAX if the required size exceeds size_t.
requirements: rowBytes is assumed to be at least minRowBytes(); pass a valid rowBytes to avoid overflow or underflow.
Callers should check for SIZE_MAX using ByteSizeOverflowed() to detect overflow.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::computeMinByteSize
functions.description: Returns the minimum total storage required for the pixel array using minRowBytes(). Returns 0 if height is 0. Returns SIZE_MAX if the size exceeds size_t.
requirements: Call ByteSizeOverflowed() on the result to detect overflow.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::ByteSizeOverflowed
functions.description: Helper that returns true if byteSize equals SIZE_MAX, indicating that computeByteSize() or computeMinByteSize() overflowed size_t.
requirements: Pass only results returned by computeByteSize() or computeMinByteSize().

functions.name: SkImageInfo::validRowBytes
functions.description: Returns true if rowBytes is large enough for a pixel row and properly aligned for this image’s color type. Alignment is checked by ensuring rowBytes is a multiple of 1<<shiftPerPixel().
requirements: rowBytes must be >= minRowBytes64().
rowBytes must be aligned such that (rowBytes >> shiftPerPixel()) << shiftPerPixel() == rowBytes.

functions.name: SkImageInfo::reset
functions.description: Resets this SkImageInfo to an empty state (unknown color/alpha, zero dimensions, no color space).

functions.name: SkImageInfo::validate
functions.description: Debug-only assertion helper (available only when SK_DEBUG is defined). Asserts that internal values are legal and consistent.
requirements: Only available when compiled with SK_DEBUG defined; do not call in release builds if not present.
Intended for debugging; may trigger assertions if inconsistencies are found.

functions.name: SkImages::RasterFromBitmap
functions.description: Creates a CPU-backed SkImage from an SkBitmap, sharing or copying the bitmap’s pixels. If the SkBitmap is immutable and its pixel memory is shareable, SkImage may share the pixels instead of copying. Returns nullptr if the bitmap is invalid.
requirements: bitmap must be valid: width and height > 0
each dimension must fit in 29 bits
SkColorType and SkAlphaType must be valid, and SkColorType must not be kUnknown_SkColorType
row bytes must be large enough for one row
pixel address must not be nullptr

functions.name: SkImages::RasterFromCompressedTextureData
functions.signature: SK_API sk_sp<SkImage> SkImages::RasterFromCompressedTextureData(sk_sp<SkData> data, int width, int height, SkTextureCompressionType type);
functions.description: Creates a CPU-backed SkImage by decompressing compressed texture data and wrapping the decompressed pixels. Any mipmap levels present in the source data are discarded. Returns nullptr if creation fails.
requirements: data should contain valid compressed texture payload matching width, height, and the specified compression type (inferred from name and params)
width and height should describe the full image dimensions and be positive (inferred)

functions.name: SkImages::DeferredFromEncodedData
functions.signature: SK_API sk_sp<SkImage> SkImages::DeferredFromEncodedData(sk_sp<const SkData> encoded, std::optional<SkAlphaType> alphaType = std::nullopt);
functions.description: Creates an SkImage from encoded data with decoding deferred until use. The result can be cached on CPU or GPU depending on usage. If alphaType is nullopt, alpha type is inferred from the encoded format; if provided, only kPremul or kUnpremul are allowed. Forcing opaque (kOpaque) is not allowed and returns nullptr. Returns nullptr if the encoded format is not supported.
requirements: encoded must contain supported encoded image data (e.g., PNG, JPEG, etc., platform-dependent)
alphaType must be either nullopt, kPremul_SkAlphaType, or kUnpremul_SkAlphaType; passing kOpaque_SkAlphaType is not allowed and results in nullptr

functions.name: SkImages::DeferredFromGenerator
functions.description: Creates an SkImage backed by a generator that produces pixels on demand (deferred until drawn). The generated data is owned by the SkImage and is not directly accessible or shareable. Returns nullptr if the generator data is invalid.
requirements: imageGenerator must be a valid SkImageGenerator capable of producing image data appropriate for the current platform (inferred from docs)

functions.name: SkImages::DeferredFromPicture
functions.signature: SK_API sk_sp<SkImage> SkImages::DeferredFromPicture(sk_sp<SkPicture> picture, const SkISize& dimensions, const SkMatrix* matrix, const SkPaint* paint, SkImages::BitDepth bitDepth, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> colorSpace, SkSurfaceProps props);
functions.description: Creates an SkImage from an SkPicture that will be rasterized when drawn. The image’s size is given by dimensions; drawing the picture will apply the optional matrix and paint, into the specified bitDepth and colorSpace, honoring the supplied surface props. Returns nullptr on failure.
requirements: picture must be a valid SkPicture
dimensions must specify positive width and height (inferred)
matrix may be nullptr (treated as identity)
paint may be nullptr (treated as default)
colorSpace may be nullptr
props must be provided

functions.name: SkImages::RasterFromPixmapCopy
functions.description: Creates a CPU-backed SkImage by copying pixel data from an SkPixmap. The SkImage will not reference the source pixels and is unaffected by later changes to the pixmap. Returns nullptr if the pixmap is invalid.
requirements: pixmap must be valid: width and height > 0
each dimension must fit in 29 bits
SkColorType and SkAlphaType must be valid, and SkColorType must not be kUnknown_SkColorType
row bytes must be large enough for one row
pixel address must not be nullptr

functions.name: SkImages::RasterFromPixmap
functions.signature: SK_API sk_sp<SkImage> SkImages::RasterFromPixmap(const SkPixmap& pixmap, SkImages::RasterReleaseProc rasterReleaseProc, SkImages::ReleaseContext releaseContext);
functions.description: Creates a CPU-backed SkImage that shares pixel memory with an SkPixmap. Pixels must remain valid and unchanged until the image releases them. When the image no longer needs the pixels, rasterReleaseProc is called with the provided releaseContext (both may be nullptr). Returns nullptr if the pixmap is invalid.
requirements: pixmap must be valid: width and height > 0
each dimension must fit in 29 bits
SkColorType and SkAlphaType must be valid, and SkColorType must not be kUnknown_SkColorType
row bytes must be large enough for one row
pixel address must not be nullptr
if provided, rasterReleaseProc must be callable for releasing the shared pixels when the SkImage is deleted or detaches from the pixels
pixels must remain valid and unchanged until rasterReleaseProc is invoked

functions.name: SkImages::RasterFromData
functions.signature: SK_API sk_sp<SkImage> SkImages::RasterFromData(const SkImageInfo& info, sk_sp<SkData> pixels, size_t rowBytes);
functions.description: Creates a CPU-backed SkImage from provided pixel data described by SkImageInfo. The data is not copied; the SkImage will share the provided storage. Returns nullptr if the info or data are invalid.
requirements: info must be valid: width and height > 0
each dimension must fit in 29 bits
SkColorType and SkAlphaType must be valid, and SkColorType must not be kUnknown_SkColorType
rowBytes must be large enough for one row
pixels sk_sp<SkData> must not be nullptr and must contain enough data for the image

functions.name: SkImages::MakeWithFilter
functions.signature: SK_API sk_sp<SkImage> SkImages::MakeWithFilter(sk_sp<SkImage> src, const SkImageFilter* filter, const SkIRect& subset, const SkIRect& clipBounds, SkIRect* outSubset, SkIPoint* offset);
functions.description: Applies an SkImageFilter to a subset of a source image on the CPU, potentially changing color, size, and position. clipBounds is the expected output bounds. On success, returns a filtered SkImage and writes the actual resulting bounds to outSubset and the translation to offset. Returns nullptr if a filtered result could not be created.
requirements: src must be a valid SkImage
filter should be a valid SkImageFilter; behavior is unknown if nullptr (not documented)
subset is the portion of src to process
clipBounds specifies expected output bounds
outSubset must be a valid pointer to receive result bounds
offset must be a valid pointer to receive translation
on failure (nullptr), outSubset and offset are undefined

functions.name: SkImage::alphaType

functions.description: Returns a raw pointer to the immutable SkColorSpace associated with the image, or nullptr if none. The reference count is unchanged.

functions.name: SkImage::refColorSpace
functions.description: Returns a smart pointer to the immutable SkColorSpace associated with the image, or nullptr if none.

functions.name: SkImage::isAlphaOnly
functions.description: Returns true if the image’s pixels represent an alpha-only mask (kAlpha_8_SkColorType).

functions.name: SkImage::makeRawShader
functions.signature: sk_sp<SkShader> SkImage::makeRawShader(SkTileMode tmx, SkTileMode tmy, const SkSamplingOptions&, const SkMatrix* localMatrix = nullptr) const;

functions.name: SkImage::peekPixels

functions.name: SkImage::isValid

functions.name: SkImage::readPixels
functions.signature: bool SkImage::readPixels(GrDirectContext* context, const SkImageInfo& dstInfo, void* dstPixels, size_t dstRowBytes, int srcX, int srcY, CachingHint cachingHint = kAllow_CachingHint) const;
functions.description: Copies a rectangle of pixels from the image into client memory described by dstInfo/dstPixels/dstRowBytes, starting at (srcX, srcY). Returns true on success. May be deprecated for Graphite in favor of async APIs.
requirements: dstPixels must not be nullptr
dstRowBytes must be >= dstInfo.minRowBytes()
source must have readable pixels (SkPixelRef not nullptr)

Pixel conversion must be possible; special cases: if image colorType is kGray_8 or kAlpha_8 then dst colorType must match; if image colorType is kGray_8 then dst colorSpace must match; if image alphaType is kOpaque then dst alphaType must match; if image colorSpace is nullptr then dst colorSpace must match
srcX and srcY may be negative; fail if width or height is <= 0
fail if abs(srcX) >= image width or abs(srcY) >= image height
context should be the GrDirectContext in play, if it exists
cachingHint controls whether Skia may cache decoded/copied pixels locally

functions.name: SkImage::asyncRescaleAndReadPixels
functions.signature: void SkImage::asyncRescaleAndReadPixels(const SkImageInfo& info, const SkIRect& srcRect, RescaleGamma rescaleGamma, RescaleMode rescaleMode, ReadPixelsCallback callback, ReadPixelsContext context) const;
functions.description: Asynchronously (when supported) reads a sub-rectangle of pixels, optionally converts to linear gamma for rescaling, rescales to info’s dimensions, and converts to info’s color type/alpha type/color space. Invokes callback with an AsyncReadResult on success or with nullptr on failure. Synchronous in non-supported backends.
requirements: srcRect must be contained within the image bounds; otherwise, failure
callback must be a valid function to receive the result
context is passed back to the callback
For GPU images, the operation flushes but a submit must occur to guarantee bounded completion time
The returned data remains valid for the lifetime of AsyncReadResult; for GPU images it is invalidated if the context is abandoned or destroyed

functions.name: SkImage::asyncRescaleAndReadPixelsYUV420
functions.signature: void SkImage::asyncRescaleAndReadPixelsYUV420(SkYUVColorSpace yuvColorSpace, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> dstColorSpace, const SkIRect& srcRect, const SkISize& dstSize, RescaleGamma rescaleGamma, RescaleMode rescaleMode, ReadPixelsCallback callback, ReadPixelsContext context) const;
functions.description: Like asyncRescaleAndReadPixels, but after rescaling converts to YUV420 and returns three planes (Y, U, V) via AsyncReadResult (count()==3). U and V planes are half the width and height. Fails if dstSize width or height are not even, or if srcRect is out of bounds. Callback receives nullptr on failure.
requirements: srcRect must be contained within the image bounds; otherwise, failure
dstSize width and height must be even
yuvColorSpace specifies RGB->YUV conversion; applied after rescaling to dstColorSpace
callback must be valid; context is passed back
For GPU images, operation flushes but requires a submit for guaranteed completion; data invalidated if context is abandoned or destroyed

functions.name: SkImage::asyncRescaleAndReadPixelsYUVA420
functions.signature: void SkImage::asyncRescaleAndReadPixelsYUVA420(SkYUVColorSpace yuvColorSpace, sk_sp<SkColorSpace> dstColorSpace, const SkIRect& srcRect, const SkISize& dstSize, RescaleGamma rescaleGamma, RescaleMode rescaleMode, ReadPixelsCallback callback, ReadPixelsContext context) const;
functions.description: Like asyncRescaleAndReadPixelsYUV420 but returns a fourth plane containing the alpha channel at full resolution (AsyncReadResult count()==4). Same constraints and lifetime rules apply.
requirements: srcRect must be contained within the image bounds; otherwise, failure
dstSize width and height should be even (by analogy to YUV420 requirement; not restated explicitly for YUVA but implied by being identical except for alpha)
callback must be valid; context is passed back
For GPU images, operation flushes but requires a submit for guaranteed completion; data invalidated if context is abandoned or destroyed
