functions.name: SkPixmap::erase
functions.signature: bool SkPixmap::erase(const SkColor4f& color, const SkIRect* subset) const
functions.description: Fills either the provided subset (if non-null) intersected with bounds(), or the entire bounds() if subset is null, using the specified unpremultiplied float color.
requirements: colorType() must not be kUnknown_SkColorType.
If subset is non-null, it must intersect bounds(); if subset is null, bounds() must be non-empty.
addr() must be non-null before writing.

functions.name: SkBitmap::SkBitmap
functions.description: Default-constructs an empty SkBitmap with unknown color/alpha types, zero width/height, pixel ref origin at (0,0), and no pixels. Use setInfo()/alloc APIs before drawing or accessing pixels.
requirements: No pixels are allocated on construction; callers must set info and allocate or install pixels before read/write operations.
After construction, drawsNothing() is true until a valid pixel ref and non-zero dimensions are set.

functions.name: SkBitmap::~SkBitmap
functions.description: Destructor; decrements the pixel ref's reference count if present, potentially freeing pixel memory if it was the last owner.
requirements: Do not use the object after destruction.
If multiple SkBitmap instances share a pixel ref, pixels are freed when the last owner is destroyed or releases it.

functions.name: SkBitmap::operator=
functions.description: Copy-assigns from another SkBitmap, copying image info and sharing the pixel ref (if present). Returns *this.
requirements: Pixels are shared; changes to shared pixels affect both bitmaps.
Self-assignment is allowed.
Existing pixel ref, if any, will be released.

functions.name: SkBitmap::swap
functions.description: Exchanges all fields (including pixel refs and bounds/origin) with another bitmap.
requirements: other must be a valid SkBitmap reference.

functions.name: SkBitmap::pixmap
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the internal SkPixmap describing the current pixel address, row bytes, and image info.
requirements: Returned reference becomes invalid if the bitmap's pixels or info change subsequently.

functions.name: SkBitmap::info
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the current SkImageInfo (dimensions, color/alpha type, color space).
requirements: Returned reference becomes invalid if the bitmap's info changes.

functions.name: SkBitmap::width
functions.description: Returns the pixel width from the bitmap's SkImageInfo.

functions.name: SkBitmap::height
functions.description: Returns the pixel height from the bitmap's SkImageInfo.

functions.name: SkBitmap::colorType
functions.description: Returns the SkColorType of the bitmap.

functions.name: SkBitmap::alphaType
functions.description: Returns the SkAlphaType of the bitmap.

functions.name: SkBitmap::colorSpace
functions.description: Returns the (immutable) SkColorSpace pointer from the image info, or nullptr if none. The ref count is unchanged.
requirements: Do not modify or free the returned pointer.
May return nullptr if no color space is associated.

functions.name: SkBitmap::refColorSpace
functions.description: Returns a smart pointer (sk_sp) to the SkColorSpace associated with the bitmap's info, increasing the ref count.
requirements: Caller should hold the returned sk_sp to extend the color space lifetime if needed.

functions.name: SkBitmap::bytesPerPixel
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes per pixel based on the color type; 0 if color type is unknown.

functions.name: SkBitmap::rowBytesAsPixels
functions.description: Returns how many pixels fit in a row given the current row bytes. Typically >= width().

functions.name: SkBitmap::shiftPerPixel
functions.description: Returns the bit shift used to convert between pixel count and byte count for the current color type (0..3).

functions.name: SkBitmap::empty
functions.description: Returns true if either width or height is zero.
requirements: Does not check for a null pixel ref; use drawsNothing() to check both.

functions.name: SkBitmap::isNull
functions.description: Returns true if no SkPixelRef is associated (i.e., pixels are not set/allocated).
requirements: Does not consider the dimensions; use drawsNothing() to check both.

functions.name: SkBitmap::drawsNothing
functions.description: Returns true if the bitmap is empty (zero width or height) or has no pixel ref. Such a bitmap has no effect when drawn.

functions.name: SkBitmap::rowBytes
functions.description: Returns the row byte stride between adjacent pixel rows. 0 if color type is unknown or if the provided rowBytes at setInfo time was insufficient.

functions.name: SkBitmap::setAlphaType
functions.description: Attempts to set the alpha type on the underlying pixel ref, subject to compatibility with the current color type. Affects all bitmaps sharing the pixel ref.
requirements: Behavior depends on current color type; some alphaType inputs are ignored or coerced as documented (e.g., A8 unpremul treated as premul; 565 and Gray force Opaque).
Returns false if attempting to set Unknown when an existing non-Unknown is present (for applicable color types).
Changes the pixel ref's state; all sharing bitmaps observe the change.

functions.name: SkBitmap::setColorSpace
functions.description: Sets the SkColorSpace in the pixel ref without modifying raw pixel values. Affects all bitmaps sharing the pixel ref.
requirements: No color conversion is performed; caller must ensure the new color space correctly describes the pixel data.
colorSpace may be nullptr to clear.
All sharing bitmaps will see the new color space.

functions.name: SkBitmap::getPixels
functions.description: Returns the writable base address of the pixels (or nullptr if unavailable).
requirements: Pixels must be allocated/installed; otherwise returns nullptr.
Respect pixel format; writing must be consistent with info().

functions.name: SkBitmap::computeByteSize
functions.description: Computes the minimum bytes required to store all pixels (height * rowBytes), excluding trailing row padding. Returns SIZE_MAX on overflow, or 0 for empty dimensions.

functions.name: SkBitmap::isImmutable
functions.description: Returns whether the pixel ref is marked immutable (read-only) and cannot be changed.

functions.name: SkBitmap::setImmutable
functions.description: Marks the pixel ref as immutable; cannot be cleared. All bitmaps sharing the pixel ref become immutable. Writes may assert in debug builds.
requirements: Once immutable, do not attempt to modify pixels.
Affects all bitmaps sharing the pixel ref.

functions.name: SkBitmap::isOpaque
functions.description: Returns true if the alpha type is marked opaque; does not validate actual pixel values or color type capabilities.
requirements: If returns true when pixels actually contain transparency, drawing may be incorrect.

functions.name: SkBitmap::reset
functions.description: Resets to initial empty state: clears info, rowBytes, pixel address, and releases any pixel ref.
requirements: Any previously obtained pixmap()/info() references become invalid after reset.

functions.name: SkBitmap::ComputeIsOpaque
functions.description: Static helper that inspects the pixmap to determine if all pixels are opaque, based on the bitmap's color type rules.
requirements: Returns false for unknown color type.
Requires readable pixels; follows underlying SkPixmap rules.

functions.name: SkBitmap::getBounds
functions.description: Writes the floating-point bounds {0,0,width,height} into bounds.
requirements: bounds must be non-null and writable.

functions.name: SkBitmap::bounds
functions.description: Returns the integer bounds rectangle from origin to width/height.

functions.name: SkBitmap::dimensions
functions.description: Returns the integer size (width, height).

functions.name: SkBitmap::getSubset
functions.description: Returns the bitmap bounds offset by the pixel ref origin within its pixel ref, i.e., the rectangle of this bitmap within its pixel ref.

functions.name: SkBitmap::setInfo
functions.signature: bool SkBitmap::setInfo(const SkImageInfo& imageInfo, size_t rowBytes = 0)
functions.description: Sets the image info (possibly adjusting alphaType for consistency) and optional rowBytes, freeing any existing pixels. Validates dimensions and rowBytes against the color type and bytes-per-pixel rules.
requirements: rowBytes must be 0 or >= imageInfo.minRowBytes(); if 0 and color type not unknown, it is treated as minRowBytes().
width and height must be non-negative; width must not exceed 31 bits; rowBytes must not exceed 31 bits; rowBytes must be >= width * bytesPerPixel when positive.
May coerce alphaType for certain color types as documented.
On failure, the bitmap is reset and false is returned.

functions.name: SkBitmap::tryAllocPixelsFlags
functions.signature: [[nodiscard]] bool SkBitmap::tryAllocPixelsFlags(const SkImageInfo& info, uint32_t flags)
functions.description: Sets info (as per setInfo) and tries to allocate zeroed pixel memory, honoring flags (currently only zeroing; always zeroed). Returns false on failure and resets the bitmap.
requirements: info must be valid per setInfo.
Allocation may succeed lazily depending on platform; do not assume physical memory is committed until written.
flags may be 0 or kZeroPixels_AllocFlag.

functions.name: SkBitmap::allocPixelsFlags
functions.signature: void SkBitmap::allocPixelsFlags(const SkImageInfo& info, uint32_t flags)
functions.description: Sets info and allocates zeroed pixel memory, aborting the process if setting info or allocation fails.
requirements: info must be valid per setInfo.
May abort the program on failure (per SK_ABORT).
flags may be 0 or kZeroPixels_AllocFlag.

functions.name: SkBitmap::tryAllocPixels
functions.signature: [[nodiscard]] bool SkBitmap::tryAllocPixels(const SkImageInfo& info, size_t rowBytes)
functions.description: Sets info (as per setInfo) and tries to allocate pixel memory with specified rowBytes (or 0 for minimum). Returns false and resets on failure.
requirements: rowBytes must be 0 or >= info.width() * info.bytesPerPixel().
Allocation may be lazy; do not assume commit until written.

functions.name: SkBitmap::tryAllocPixels
functions.description: Sets info and tries to allocate pixel memory using minRowBytes(). Returns false and resets on failure.
requirements: info must be valid per setInfo.
Allocation may be lazy; do not assume commit until written.

functions.name: SkBitmap::allocPixels
functions.signature: void SkBitmap::allocPixels(const SkImageInfo& info, size_t rowBytes)
functions.description: Sets info (as per setInfo) and allocates pixel memory with specified rowBytes (or 0 for minimum), aborting on failure.
requirements: rowBytes must be 0 or >= info.width() * info.bytesPerPixel().
May abort the program on failure (per SK_ABORT).

functions.name: SkBitmap::allocPixels
functions.description: Sets info and allocates pixel memory using minRowBytes(), aborting on failure.
requirements: info must be valid per setInfo.
May abort the program on failure (per SK_ABORT).

functions.name: SkBitmap::tryAllocN32Pixels
functions.signature: [[nodiscard]] bool SkBitmap::tryAllocN32Pixels(int width, int height, bool isOpaque = false)
functions.description: Configures the bitmap to native 32-bit color type (SkPMColor) with either Opaque or Premul alpha, and tries to allocate pixel memory.
requirements: width and height must be >= 0; width must not exceed 29 bits.
If isOpaque is true, alphaType becomes Opaque; otherwise Premul.
Returns false on allocation or validation failure.

functions.name: SkBitmap::allocN32Pixels
functions.signature: void SkBitmap::allocN32Pixels(int width, int height, bool isOpaque = false)
functions.description: Configures the bitmap to native 32-bit color type (SkPMColor) with Opaque or Premul alpha, and allocates pixels, aborting on failure.
requirements: width and height must be >= 0; width must not exceed 29 bits.
May abort the program on failure (per SK_ABORT).

functions.name: SkBitmap::installPixels
functions.signature: bool SkBitmap::installPixels(const SkImageInfo& info, void* pixels, size_t rowBytes, void (*releaseProc)(void* addr, void* context), void* context)
functions.description: Sets info (as per setInfo) and installs caller-provided pixels/rowBytes into a new pixel ref, optionally with a release callback invoked on failure or when pixels are no longer referenced.
requirements: info must be valid per setInfo; rowBytes must be >= info.minRowBytes().
pixels may be nullptr to install just the info (no pixels).
If releaseProc is provided and pixels are accepted, it will be called with addr/context when pixels are no longer referenced.
On invalid info/rowBytes, reset is called and false returned (releaseProc invoked immediately if provided).
Caller must ensure provided pixels remain valid until releaseProc is called or bitmap goes out of scope if no releaseProc provided.

functions.name: SkBitmap::setPixels
functions.description: Replaces the pixel ref with the provided base address, preserving current info and rowBytes; origin set to (0,0). If pixels is nullptr or color type is unknown, releases any existing pixel ref.
requirements: Caller retains ownership of pixel memory and must keep it valid for the lifetime of the bitmap/pixel ref.
info().colorType() must not be kUnknown_SkColorType to install non-null pixels.
Pixels must match current SkImageInfo format and rowBytes.

functions.name: SkBitmap::pixelRef
functions.description: Returns the underlying SkPixelRef pointer without altering its ref count, or nullptr if none.
requirements: Do not store the raw pointer beyond the bitmap's lifetime unless you manage refs elsewhere.

functions.name: SkBitmap::pixelRefOrigin
functions.description: Returns the origin of the bitmap's subset within its pixel ref; (0,0) if no pixel ref.

functions.name: SkBitmap::setPixelRef
functions.signature: void SkBitmap::setPixelRef(sk_sp<SkPixelRef> pixelRef, int dx, int dy)
functions.description: Replaces the pixel ref and sets the origin offset (dx,dy) of the bitmap within that pixel ref. Pins dx/dy to valid range in release; asserts on invalid in debug.
requirements: dx and dy must be within the bounds implied by pixelRef dimensions and current bitmap size.
Caller must ensure the new pixel ref's pixels match the bitmap's SkColorType and SkAlphaType.

functions.name: SkBitmap::readyToDraw
functions.description: Returns true if getPixels() is non-null, indicating pixels are ready for drawing.

functions.name: SkBitmap::getGenerationID
functions.description: Returns a non-zero ID that uniquely identifies the current pixel content. Changes after notifyPixelsChanged(). Returns 0 if no pixel ref.
requirements: Do not assume IDs are monotonically increasing across different bitmaps; only use to detect changes.

functions.name: SkBitmap::notifyPixelsChanged
functions.description: Marks the pixel ref as changed so future generation IDs differ.
requirements: Call after modifying pixels when sharing pixel refs so caches and dependents can detect changes.

functions.name: SkBitmap::eraseColor
functions.description: Fills the entire bitmap bounds with the given unpremultiplied SkColor4f (interpreted in sRGB). For Gray8 or RGB565, alpha is ignored; for Alpha8, RGB is ignored.
requirements: Bitmap must have writable pixels; behavior undefined if no pixels.
Color is interpreted as unpremultiplied in sRGB; internal conversion occurs as needed.

functions.name: SkBitmap::eraseColor
functions.description: Fills the entire bitmap bounds with the given unpremultiplied SkColor (sRGB). For Gray8 or RGB565, alpha is ignored; for Alpha8, RGB is ignored.
requirements: Bitmap must have writable pixels; behavior undefined if no pixels.
SkColor is converted to SkColor4f internally; precision may be reduced compared to SkColor4f overload.

functions.name: SkBitmap::eraseARGB
functions.signature: void SkBitmap::eraseARGB(U8CPU a, U8CPU r, U8CPU g, U8CPU b) const
functions.description: Fills the entire bitmap with the unpremultiplied sRGB color built from components (a,r,g,b). Convenience wrapper around eraseColor(SkColor).
requirements: Bitmap must have writable pixels.

functions.name: SkBitmap::erase
functions.signature: void SkBitmap::erase(SkColor4f c, const SkIRect& area) const
functions.description: Fills the specified integer area (intersection with bounds) with the given unpremultiplied SkColor4f (sRGB). Alpha ignored for Gray8/RGB565; RGB ignored for Alpha8.
requirements: Area is clipped to bitmap bounds; if no intersection, no effect.
Bitmap must have writable pixels.

functions.name: SkBitmap::erase
functions.signature: void SkBitmap::erase(SkColor c, const SkIRect& area) const
functions.description: Fills the specified area (clipped to bounds) with the given unpremultiplied SkColor (sRGB). Alpha ignored for Gray8/RGB565; RGB ignored for Alpha8.
requirements: Area is clipped to bitmap bounds; if no intersection, no effect.
Bitmap must have writable pixels.

functions.name: SkBitmap::eraseArea
functions.signature: void SkBitmap::eraseArea(const SkIRect& area, SkColor c) const
functions.description: Deprecated alias for erase(SkColor, area).
requirements: Same as erase(SkColor, area).

functions.name: SkBitmap::getColor
functions.signature: SkColor SkBitmap::getColor(int x, int y) const
functions.description: Returns the pixel at (x,y) converted to an unpremultiplied SkColor. For Alpha8, returns black with the pixel’s alpha. Ignores color space.
requirements: x and y must be within [0,width) and [0,height); out-of-bounds triggers assert in debug and is undefined in release.
Fails/undefined if color type is unknown or pixel address is null.
Precision may be lost during conversion.

functions.name: SkBitmap::getColor4f
functions.signature: SkColor4f SkBitmap::getColor4f(int x, int y) const
functions.description: Returns the pixel at (x,y) converted to an unpremultiplied SkColor4f. For Alpha8, returns black with alpha. Ignores color space.
requirements: x and y must be within bounds; invalid access asserts in debug and is undefined in release.
Requires readable pixels; unknown color type or null pixels cause failure/undefined behavior.

functions.name: SkBitmap::getAlphaf
functions.signature: float SkBitmap::getAlphaf(int x, int y) const
functions.description: Returns the normalized alpha [0..1] of the pixel at (x,y). More efficient and possibly more precise than extracting from SkColor.
requirements: x and y must be within bounds; invalid access asserts in debug.
Requires readable pixels.

functions.name: SkBitmap::getAddr
functions.signature: void* SkBitmap::getAddr(int x, int y) const
functions.description: Returns a generic pointer to the pixel at (x,y), or nullptr for unknown color type or no pixel ref. Prefer type-specific getAddr* for performance.
requirements: x and y must be within bounds; invalid access asserts in debug and is undefined in release.
SkColorType must be known and pixels present.

functions.name: SkBitmap::getAddr32
functions.signature: uint32_t* SkBitmap::getAddr32(int x, int y) const
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the 32-bit pixel at (x,y). Asserts in debug if no pixels, bytesPerPixel()!=4, or out-of-bounds.
requirements: Bitmap must have pixels; bytesPerPixel() must be 4.
x and y must be within bounds.

functions.name: SkBitmap::getAddr16
functions.signature: uint16_t* SkBitmap::getAddr16(int x, int y) const
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the 16-bit pixel at (x,y). Asserts in debug if no pixels, bytesPerPixel()!=2, or out-of-bounds.
requirements: Bitmap must have pixels; bytesPerPixel() must be 2.
x and y must be within bounds.

functions.name: SkBitmap::getAddr8
functions.signature: uint8_t* SkBitmap::getAddr8(int x, int y) const
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the 8-bit pixel at (x,y). Asserts in debug if no pixels, bytesPerPixel()!=1, or out-of-bounds.
requirements: Bitmap must have pixels; bytesPerPixel() must be 1.
x and y must be within bounds.

functions.name: SkBitmap::extractSubset
functions.signature: bool SkBitmap::extractSubset(SkBitmap* dst, const SkIRect& subset) const
functions.description: Sets dst to reference a sub-rectangle of this bitmap, sharing the same pixel ref. dst bounds become the intersection of subset and this bitmap's bounds.
requirements: dst must be non-null and writable; any previous contents are discarded.
This bitmap must have a pixel ref; subset must intersect bounds.
Pixels are shared; modifying shared pixels affects both bitmaps.

functions.name: SkBitmap::readPixels
functions.signature: bool SkBitmap::readPixels(const SkImageInfo& dstInfo, void* dstPixels, size_t dstRowBytes, int srcX, int srcY) const
functions.description: Copies a rectangle of pixels starting at (srcX,srcY) into client memory described by dstInfo/dstPixels/dstRowBytes. Performs format conversion only when allowed by specific rules.
requirements: dstPixels must be non-null; dstRowBytes >= dstInfo.minRowBytes().
This bitmap must have a pixel ref.
srcX/srcY may be negative but |srcX|<width and |srcY|<height; width() and height() must be >0.
Conversions allowed only per rules: Gray8/Alpha8 require matching dst color type (and for Gray8, matching color space); Opaque alpha type must match; null colorSpace requires matching dst colorSpace.

functions.name: SkBitmap::readPixels
functions.signature: bool SkBitmap::readPixels(const SkPixmap& dst, int srcX, int srcY) const
functions.description: Copies pixels into a destination SkPixmap starting at (srcX,srcY). Performs format conversion only when allowed by rules analogous to the SkImageInfo overload.
requirements: dst.addr() must be non-null; dst.rowBytes() >= dst.info().minRowBytes().
This bitmap must have a pixel ref.
srcX/srcY constraints and conversion rules are as documented for the SkImageInfo overload.

functions.name: SkBitmap::readPixels
functions.description: Copies pixels into dst starting at source origin (0,0). Equivalent to readPixels(dst, 0, 0).
requirements: Same requirements as readPixels(const SkPixmap&, int, int).

functions.name: SkBitmap::writePixels
functions.signature: bool SkBitmap::writePixels(const SkPixmap& src, int dstX, int dstY)
functions.description: Copies a rectangle of pixels from src into this bitmap at (dstX,dstY). Performs format conversion only when allowed by specific rules.
requirements: src.addr() must be non-null; src.rowBytes() >= src.info().minRowBytes().
This bitmap must have a pixel ref; width() and height() must be >0.
dstX/dstY may be negative but |dstX|<width and |dstY|<height.
Conversions allowed only per rules: Gray8/Alpha8 require matching src color type; Gray8 requires matching color space; Opaque alpha type must match; null colorSpace requires matching color space.

functions.name: SkBitmap::writePixels
functions.description: Copies pixels from src into this bitmap at origin (0,0). Equivalent to writePixels(src, 0, 0).
requirements: Same requirements as writePixels(const SkPixmap&, int, int).

functions.name: SkBitmap::extractAlpha
functions.description: Generates an alpha-only bitmap from this bitmap into dst, allocating pixels via HeapAllocator. Returns false if dst cannot be written or allocation fails.
requirements: dst must be non-null and writable.
May fail if allocation fails.

functions.name: SkBitmap::extractAlpha
functions.signature: bool SkBitmap::extractAlpha(SkBitmap* dst, const SkPaint* paint, SkIPoint* offset) const
functions.description: Generates an alpha-only bitmap into dst. If paint contains an SkMaskFilter, it is used to produce the mask; offset returns the top-left alignment of dst relative to the source.
requirements: dst must be non-null and writable.
paint may be null; if provided and has a mask filter, offset may be adjusted accordingly.
offset may be null if not needed.

functions.name: SkBitmap::extractAlpha
functions.signature: bool SkBitmap::extractAlpha(SkBitmap* dst, const SkPaint* paint, Allocator* allocator, SkIPoint* offset) const
functions.description: Generates an alpha-only bitmap into dst using an optional mask filter from paint and allocating with a provided Allocator (or HeapAllocator if null). Returns alignment offset if requested.
requirements: dst must be non-null and writable.
allocator may be null to use HeapAllocator.
paint and offset are optional; if a mask filter is used, offset may be non-zero.

functions.name: SkBitmap::peekPixels
functions.description: If readable pixel address is available, fills pixmap with the current pixel state and returns true; otherwise returns false and leaves pixmap unchanged.
requirements: pixmap must be non-null and writable.
Returned pixmap becomes invalid if the bitmap's pixels or info change later.

functions.name: SkBitmap::makeShader
functions.signature: sk_sp<SkShader> SkBitmap::makeShader(SkTileMode tmx, SkTileMode tmy, const SkSamplingOptions& sampling, const SkMatrix* localMatrix = nullptr) const
functions.description: Creates a shader sampling this bitmap with specified tiling modes in X/Y, sampling options, and optional local matrix.
requirements: Bitmap must be readable; drawsNothing() may produce a valid but ineffective shader.
localMatrix may be nullptr for identity.

functions.name: SkBitmap::makeShader
functions.signature: sk_sp<SkShader> SkBitmap::makeShader(SkTileMode tmx, SkTileMode tmy, const SkSamplingOptions& sampling, const SkMatrix& lm) const
functions.description: Creates a shader with specified tiling, sampling, and a required local matrix.
requirements: Bitmap should be readable.
lm is applied as the local transformation.

functions.name: SkBitmap::makeShader
functions.signature: sk_sp<SkShader> SkBitmap::makeShader(const SkSamplingOptions& sampling, const SkMatrix& lm) const
functions.description: Creates a shader with clamp tiling in both directions, specified sampling, and a required local matrix.
requirements: Bitmap should be readable.

functions.name: SkBitmap::makeShader
functions.signature: sk_sp<SkShader> SkBitmap::makeShader(const SkSamplingOptions& sampling, const SkMatrix* lm = nullptr) const
functions.description: Creates a shader with clamp tiling, specified sampling, and optional local matrix.
requirements: Bitmap should be readable.
lm may be nullptr for identity.

functions.name: SkBitmap::asImage
functions.description: Returns a new SkImage representing this bitmap. Shares pixels if the bitmap is immutable; otherwise copies the pixels.
requirements: Copying may incur a memory cost if the bitmap is mutable.
Resulting image is immutable.

functions.name: SkBitmap::validate
functions.description: Debug-only validation of internal invariants; asserts if illegal/inconsistent state is detected. Available only when SK_DEBUG is defined.
requirements: Only callable in debug builds; may be compiled out in release builds.

functions.name: SkBitmap::Allocator::allocPixelRef
functions.description: Abstract method to allocate and install a pixel ref for the given bitmap, based on its current SkImageInfo. Implementations must call setPixels() or setPixelRef() on success.
requirements: bitmap must be non-null and contain valid SkImageInfo describing target allocation.
Implementations should return true only if pixels were successfully installed.

functions.name: SkBitmap::HeapAllocator::allocPixelRef
functions.description: Allocates pixel memory from the heap for the bitmap and installs it as the pixel ref. Default allocator used by allocPixels().
requirements: bitmap must be non-null and contain valid SkImageInfo.
Returns true on success, where setPixels() or setPixelRef() was called.

functions.name: SkCanvas::MakeRasterDirect
functions.signature: static std::unique_ptr<SkCanvas> SkCanvas::MakeRasterDirect(const SkImageInfo& info, void* pixels, size_t rowBytes, const SkSurfaceProps* props = nullptr)
functions.description: Create a raster canvas that draws directly into the caller-provided pixel buffer. Use when you want SkCanvas rendering into memory you manage. Pixels are not initialized; call flush()/peekPixels() to observe results.
requirements: info.width() and info.height() must be zero or positive
info.colorType() and info.alphaType() must be supported by raster surfaces
pixels must be non-null
rowBytes == 0 uses info.width() and pixel size to compute; if > 0 it must be >= info.width() * bytesPerPixel(info.colorType())
Pixel buffer size should be at least info.height() * computedRowBytes
props may be null; if provided describe surface properties
Returns nullptr on invalid parameters

functions.name: SkCanvas::MakeRasterDirectN32
functions.signature: static std::unique_ptr<SkCanvas> SkCanvas::MakeRasterDirectN32(int width, int height, SkPMColor* pixels, size_t rowBytes)
functions.description: Convenience helper to create a raster canvas with N32 premultiplied format (kN32_SkColorType, kPremul). Pixels are supplied by the caller.
requirements: width and height must be zero or positive
pixels must be non-null
rowBytes == 0 uses width and pixel size to compute; if > 0 it must be >= width * 4 bytes
Pixel buffer size should be at least height * rowBytes
Returns nullptr on invalid parameters

functions.name: SkCanvas::SkCanvas
functions.description: Construct an empty canvas with no backing device/pixels; its width and height are zero. Primarily useful as a base for subclasses or to be initialized later.
requirements: No backing pixels; most draw/read operations will be no-ops or invalid until associated with a device/surface

functions.name: SkCanvas::imageInfo
functions.description: Return the image info of the canvas’ current base surface/device. If the canvas is not backed by raster or GPU surface, colorType is kUnknown.
requirements: None

functions.name: SkCanvas::getProps
functions.description: Deprecated. If the canvas has associated surface props, copy them into props and return true; otherwise, return false and leave props unchanged.
requirements: props must be a valid non-null pointer to receive properties
Prefer using getBaseProps() or getTopProps() instead

functions.name: SkCanvas::getBaseProps
functions.description: Return the SkSurfaceProps at the base (root) of the layer stack.
requirements: None

functions.name: SkCanvas::getTopProps
functions.description: Return the currently active SkSurfaceProps at the top of the layer stack (may differ from base when saveLayer flags affect props).
requirements: None

functions.name: SkCanvas::getBaseLayerSize
functions.description: Return the size (width,height) of the base/root layer in canvas (global) coordinates. The base origin is (0,0).
requirements: None

functions.name: SkCanvas::makeSurface
functions.signature: sk_sp<SkSurface> SkCanvas::makeSurface(const SkImageInfo& info, const SkSurfaceProps* props = nullptr)
functions.description: Create an SkSurface compatible with this canvas (e.g., matching color space/props) and associate it with the canvas. Returns nullptr if not possible.
requirements: info specifies desired surface format and size
props may be null to match canvas’ props; if canvas has no props, defaults are used

functions.name: SkCanvas::recordingContext
functions.description: Return the Ganesh (GPU) recording context if the canvas is backed by a GPU surface; otherwise nullptr.
requirements: Only valid/nonnull for GPU-backed canvases using Ganesh

functions.name: SkCanvas::recorder
functions.description: Return the Graphite Recorder for a GPU-backed canvas using Graphite; otherwise nullptr.
requirements: Only valid/nonnull for Graphite-backed canvases

functions.name: SkCanvas::baseRecorder
functions.description: Return the underlying recorder for the surface associated with this canvas. Should be non-null.
requirements: Intended for canvases that record drawing commands; expect non-null

functions.name: SkCanvas::getSurface

functions.name: SkPaint::setAlphaf
functions.description: Sets only the alpha component of the paint color using a float in [0,1]. Out-of-range values trigger an assert in debug builds.
requirements: a must be in the range [0.0, 1.0]; out-of-range triggers an assert in debug builds.

functions.name: SkPaint::setAlpha
functions.description: Sets only the alpha component of the paint color using an integer in [0,255]; internally converted to float by dividing by 255.
requirements: a must be an integer in [0, 255].

functions.name: SkPaint::setARGB
functions.signature: void SkPaint::setARGB(U8CPU a, U8CPU r, U8CPU g, U8CPU b)
functions.description: Sets the unpremultiplied color using separate 8-bit A, R, G, B components (0..255 each).
requirements: a, r, g, b must each be in [0, 255].
Color is unpremultiplied; alpha controls transparency independently of RGB.

functions.name: SkPaint::getStrokeWidth
functions.description: Returns the stroke width. Zero indicates hairline (device-space 1-pixel wide).

functions.name: SkPaint::setStrokeWidth
functions.description: Sets the stroke width. Zero is hairline (always 1 device pixel). Negative widths are invalid and have no effect.
requirements: width < 0 is invalid and has no effect.
width == 0 selects hairline stroke behavior.

functions.name: SkPaint::getStrokeMiter
functions.description: Returns the current miter limit used for miter joins.

functions.name: SkPaint::setStrokeMiter
functions.description: Sets the miter limit controlling when sharp corners become bevels. Values < 1 are treated as bevel; negative values have no effect.
requirements: If miterLimit < 0, the call has no effect.
Values less than 1 will be treated as bevel.
Documented as a zero-or-greater miter limit.

functions.name: SkPaint::getStrokeCap
functions.description: Returns the cap style used at the start and end of open stroke contours.

functions.name: SkPaint::setStrokeCap
functions.description: Sets the cap style for stroke ends (butt, round, square).

functions.name: SkPaint::getStrokeJoin
functions.description: Returns the join style used at stroke corners (miter, round, bevel).

functions.name: SkPaint::setStrokeJoin
functions.description: Sets the join style used at stroke corners (miter, round, bevel).

functions.name: SkPaint::getShader
functions.description: Returns the current shader raw pointer without changing its refcount, or nullptr if none is set.

functions.name: SkPaint::refShader
functions.description: Returns a ref-counted smart pointer to the current shader, incrementing its refcount; nullptr if none.

functions.name: SkPaint::setShader
functions.description: Sets the shader used to provide color when filling. Decrements the previous shader’s refcount; increments the new shader’s refcount. Pass nullptr to use the solid color instead.
requirements: Passing nullptr clears the shader so solid color is used.

functions.name: SkPaint::getColorFilter
functions.description: Returns the current color filter raw pointer without changing its refcount, or nullptr if none is set.

functions.name: SkPaint::refColorFilter
functions.description: Returns a ref-counted smart pointer to the current color filter, incrementing its refcount; nullptr if none.

functions.name: SkPaint::setColorFilter
functions.description: Sets the color filter. Decrements the previous filter’s refcount; increments the new filter’s refcount. Pass nullptr to clear the color filter.
requirements: Passing nullptr clears the color filter.

functions.name: SkPaint::asBlendMode
functions.description: Returns the paint’s blend mode if its current blender can be represented as a SkBlendMode; otherwise returns an empty optional.

functions.name: SkPaint::getBlendMode_or
functions.description: Returns the blend mode if the current blender can be represented as a SkBlendMode; otherwise returns defaultMode.

functions.name: SkPaint::isSrcOver
functions.description: Returns true if the current blender is equivalent to SkBlendMode::kSrcOver or if no blender is set (nullptr).

functions.name: SkPaint::setBlendMode
functions.description: Convenience to set the paint’s blender to one implementing the specified SkBlendMode.

functions.name: SkPaint::getBlender
functions.description: Returns the current blender raw pointer without changing its refcount, or nullptr implying default SrcOver behavior.

functions.name: SkPaint::refBlender
functions.description: Returns a ref-counted smart pointer to the current blender, incrementing its refcount; nullptr implies default SrcOver behavior.

functions.name: SkPaint::setBlender
functions.description: Sets the paint’s blender. Increments the new blender’s refcount and decrements the previous one. Passing nullptr selects the default SrcOver behavior.
requirements: Passing nullptr selects the default SrcOver behavior.

functions.name: SkPaint::getPathEffect
functions.description: Returns the current path effect raw pointer without changing its refcount, or nullptr if none is set.

functions.name: SkPaint::refPathEffect
functions.description: Returns a ref-counted smart pointer to the current path effect, incrementing its refcount; nullptr if none.

functions.name: SkPaint::setPathEffect
functions.description: Sets the path effect to modify geometry when drawn. Decrements the previous effect’s refcount; increments the new effect’s refcount. Pass nullptr to clear the path effect.
requirements: Passing nullptr clears the path effect (no path modification).

functions.name: SkPaint::getMaskFilter
functions.description: Returns the current mask filter raw pointer without changing its refcount, or nullptr if none is set.

functions.name: SkPaint::refMaskFilter
functions.description: Returns a ref-counted smart pointer to the current mask filter, incrementing its refcount; nullptr if none.

functions.name: SkPaint::setMaskFilter
functions.description: Sets the mask filter affecting the generated mask’s alpha. Decrements the previous filter’s refcount; increments the new filter’s refcount. Pass nullptr to clear the mask filter.
requirements: Passing nullptr clears the mask filter.

functions.name: SkPaint::getImageFilter
functions.description: Returns the current image filter raw pointer without changing its refcount, or nullptr if none is set.

functions.name: SkPaint::refImageFilter
functions.description: Returns a ref-counted smart pointer to the current image filter, incrementing its refcount; nullptr if none.

functions.name: SkPaint::setImageFilter
functions.description: Sets the image filter applied to drawing. Decrements the previous filter’s refcount; increments the new filter’s refcount. Pass nullptr to clear the image filter.
requirements: Passing nullptr clears the image filter.

functions.name: SkPaint::nothingToDraw
functions.description: Returns true if this paint would prevent all drawing (e.g., blending and alpha resolve to zero coverage).

functions.name: SkPaint::canComputeFastBounds
functions.description: Returns true if the paint has no complex effects requiring expensive bound computation (e.g., no path effect), allowing fast bounds calculations.

functions.name: SkPaint::computeFastBounds
functions.signature: const SkRect& SkPaint::computeFastBounds(const SkRect& orig, SkRect* storage) const
functions.description: Adjusts raw bounds for stylistic effects (e.g., stroke) to produce fast-reject bounds. Only valid to call if canComputeFastBounds() returned true. The returned reference is either orig or storage.
requirements: Call only if canComputeFastBounds() returns true.
storage must not be nullptr.
Do not assume storage contains the result; always use the returned SkRect reference, which may alias orig or storage.

functions.name: SkPaint::computeFastStrokeBounds
functions.signature: const SkRect& SkPaint::computeFastStrokeBounds(const SkRect& orig, SkRect* storage) const
functions.description: Computes fast bounds as if the paint style were kStroke, without changing the current style. Delegates to doComputeFastBounds.

functions.name: SkPaint::doComputeFastBounds
functions.signature: const SkRect& SkPaint::doComputeFastBounds(const SkRect& orig, SkRect* storage, SkPaint::Style style) const
functions.description: Computes fast bounds using the provided style override (e.g., to account for stroke effects while the paint is set to fill).
requirements: style specifies the style override used for the computation.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::bounds
functions.description: Returns a conservative bounding box for the entire text blob by unioning per-glyph bounds using each run’s paint/font settings. Useful for quick culling; may be larger than the true tight bounds.
requirements: The returned SkRect reference remains valid for the lifetime of the SkTextBlob instance.
Bounds are conservative and may overestimate the true visible area.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::uniqueID
functions.description: Returns a non-zero identifier unique among all SkTextBlob instances. Can be used as a stable cache key component for the blob’s lifetime.
requirements: The returned ID is unique per blob but not guaranteed to remain unique after the blob is destroyed (do not persist beyond lifetime).

functions.name: SkTextBlob::getIntercepts
functions.signature: int SkTextBlob::getIntercepts(const SkScalar bounds[2], SkScalar intervals[], const SkPaint* paint) const
functions.description: Computes intersections between the blob’s glyph outlines and two lines parallel to text advance, defined by the lower/upper scalar values in bounds. The count returned is zero or a multiple of two; optionally fills intervals with intersection pairs. Runs using SkRSXform are ignored.
requirements: bounds must point to an array of two SkScalar values: {lower, upper} for lines parallel to advance.
intervals may be null to query the pair count without receiving values.
If intervals is non-null, the caller must provide enough space to hold the returned number of scalars (2 per intersection).
paint may be null; when provided, its stroke settings and path effects may affect results.
Return value is at most twice the number of glyphs in the blob and is a multiple of two.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromText
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromText(const void* text, size_t byteLength, const SkFont& font, SkTextEncoding encoding)
functions.description: Creates a text blob containing a single run from the provided text buffer in the specified encoding. Uses the SkFont’s typeface for character-to-glyph mapping (for UTF encodings), with no fallback, kerning, or complex shaping; glyphs are positioned by default advances.
requirements: text points to a buffer of length byteLength encoded per encoding.
encoding may be SkTextEncoding::kUTF8, kUTF16, kUTF32, or kGlyphID; for UTF encodings, default mapping from the font’s typeface is used without fallback.
font supplies size, typeface, and related text metrics used for the run.
No kerning or complex shaping is performed; positions follow default advances.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromString
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromString(const char* string, const SkFont& font, SkTextEncoding encoding)
functions.description: Convenience overload that creates a single-run text blob from a C string (default UTF-8). Behaves like MakeFromText with strlen(string) bytes. Returns nullptr if string is null.
requirements: string must be non-null to create a blob; null returns nullptr.
encoding controls how string bytes are interpreted (default UTF-8).
No fallback, kerning, or complex shaping is performed; positions follow default advances.
font provides the metrics and typeface for glyph mapping.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosTextH
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosTextH(const void* text, size_t byteLength, SkSpan<const SkScalar> xpos, SkScalar constY, const SkFont& font, SkTextEncoding encoding)
functions.description: Creates a single-run text blob positioned using per-glyph x positions and a shared y (constY). Equivalent to using SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunPosH. Returns nullptr if byteLength is zero.
requirements: text points to byteLength bytes encoded per encoding; if byteLength is zero, returns nullptr.
xpos must contain an x position for each character/glyph implied by the text and encoding.
constY is applied to all glyphs as their y position.
font supplies glyph metrics; no kerning or shaping is performed beyond per-glyph positioning.
encoding specifies text interpretation; for kGlyphID, text is glyph IDs.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosTextH
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosTextH(const void* text, size_t byteLength, const SkScalar xpos[], SkScalar constY, const SkFont& font, SkTextEncoding encoding)
functions.description: C-array overload (available when SK_SUPPORT_UNSPANNED_APIS is enabled) to create a single-run blob with per-glyph x positions and a shared y. Internally forwards to the SkSpan version. Returns nullptr if byteLength is zero.
requirements: Availability depends on being compiled with SK_SUPPORT_UNSPANNED_APIS.
text points to byteLength bytes per encoding; if byteLength is zero, returns nullptr.
xpos must provide one x value per glyph implied by text/encoding.
constY is applied to all glyphs.
font provides metrics and typeface.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosText
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosText(const void* text, size_t byteLength, SkSpan<const SkPoint> pos, const SkFont& font, SkTextEncoding encoding)
functions.description: Creates a single-run text blob with an explicit SkPoint position for each glyph. Equivalent to SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunPos. Returns nullptr if byteLength is zero.
requirements: text points to byteLength bytes per encoding; if byteLength is zero, returns nullptr.
pos must supply one SkPoint per glyph implied by the text and encoding.
font supplies glyph metrics; no shaping/kerning is implied.
encoding specifies text interpretation; for kGlyphID, text is glyph IDs.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosText
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosText(const void* text, size_t byteLength, const SkPoint pos[], const SkFont& font, SkTextEncoding encoding)
functions.description: C-array overload (available when SK_SUPPORT_UNSPANNED_APIS is enabled) to create a single-run blob with per-glyph SkPoint positions. Internally forwards to the SkSpan version. Returns nullptr if byteLength is zero.
requirements: Availability depends on being compiled with SK_SUPPORT_UNSPANNED_APIS.
text points to byteLength bytes per encoding; if byteLength is zero, returns nullptr.
pos must provide one SkPoint per glyph implied by text/encoding.
font provides metrics and typeface.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromRSXform
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromRSXform(const void* text, size_t byteLength, SkSpan<const SkRSXform> xform, const SkFont& font, SkTextEncoding encoding)
functions.description: Creates a single-run text blob with an SkRSXform transform per glyph, enabling rotation/scale about a per-glyph origin. Returns nullptr if byteLength is zero.
requirements: text points to byteLength bytes per encoding; if byteLength is zero, returns nullptr.
xform must provide one SkRSXform per glyph implied by the text and encoding.
font supplies glyph metrics; per-glyph transforms control placement.
encoding specifies text interpretation; for kGlyphID, text is glyph IDs.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromRSXform
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromRSXform(const void* text, size_t byteLength, const SkRSXform xform[], const SkFont& font, SkTextEncoding encoding)
functions.description: C-array overload (available when SK_SUPPORT_UNSPANNED_APIS is enabled) to create a single-run blob with per-glyph SkRSXform transforms. Internally forwards to the SkSpan version. Returns nullptr if byteLength is zero.
requirements: Availability depends on being compiled with SK_SUPPORT_UNSPANNED_APIS.
text points to byteLength bytes per encoding; if byteLength is zero, returns nullptr.
xform must provide one SkRSXform per glyph implied by text/encoding.
font provides metrics and typeface.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosHGlyphs
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosHGlyphs(SkSpan<const SkGlyphID> glyphs, SkSpan<const SkScalar> xpos, SkScalar constY, const SkFont& font)
functions.description: Helper that builds a single-run blob from glyph IDs with per-glyph x positions and a shared y. Wraps MakeFromPosTextH with kGlyphID encoding.
requirements: glyphs contains glyph IDs; must have one x position in xpos per glyph.
constY is applied to all glyphs as their y position.
font defines rendering metrics for the glyph IDs.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosGlyphs
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromPosGlyphs(SkSpan<const SkGlyphID> glyphs, SkSpan<const SkPoint> pos, const SkFont& font)
functions.description: Helper that builds a single-run blob from glyph IDs with explicit SkPoint positions. Wraps MakeFromPosText with kGlyphID encoding.
requirements: glyphs contains glyph IDs; pos must supply one SkPoint per glyph.
font defines rendering metrics for the glyph IDs.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::MakeFromRSXformGlyphs
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::MakeFromRSXformGlyphs(SkSpan<const SkGlyphID> glyphs, SkSpan<const SkRSXform> xform, const SkFont& font)
functions.description: Helper that builds a single-run blob from glyph IDs with per-glyph SkRSXform transforms. Wraps MakeFromRSXform with kGlyphID encoding.
requirements: glyphs contains glyph IDs; xform must supply one SkRSXform per glyph.
font defines rendering metrics for the glyph IDs.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::serialize
functions.signature: size_t SkTextBlob::serialize(const SkSerialProcs& procs, void* memory, size_t memory_size) const
functions.description: Serializes the blob into a caller-provided buffer using optional custom typeface encoders. Returns the number of bytes written if the buffer is large enough; otherwise returns 0.
requirements: memory must point to writable storage of size at least the required serialized size to receive non-zero return; otherwise 0 is returned and no full serialization occurs.
memory_size specifies the size of memory in bytes and must match the provided buffer.
procs may be null; when provided, procs.fTypefaceProc may supply custom SkTypeface encoding with procs.fTypefaceCtx passed through.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::serialize
functions.description: Serializes the blob and returns an SkData containing the encoded bytes, using optional custom typeface encoders.
requirements: procs may be null; when provided, procs.fTypefaceProc may supply custom SkTypeface encoding with procs.fTypefaceCtx passed through.
Returned SkData holds the serialized bytes and must be ref-counted as usual.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::Deserialize
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTextBlob> SkTextBlob::Deserialize(const void* data, size_t size, const SkDeserialProcs& procs)
functions.description: Reconstructs an SkTextBlob from serialized data using optional custom typeface decoders. Returns nullptr on failure (insufficient size or invalid data).
requirements: data must point to a buffer of length size containing a serialized SkTextBlob.
Returns nullptr if size is smaller than required or data is invalid.
procs may be null; when provided, procs.fTypefaceProc may supply custom typeface decoding and receives the typeface data pointer, its length, and user context.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::Iter::Iter
functions.description: Constructs an iterator to walk the runs contained in a text blob.
requirements: The referenced SkTextBlob must outlive the iterator, as the iterator references internal run storage.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::Iter::next
functions.description: Advances to the next run in the text blob. Returns true while runs remain and fills the provided Run struct (if not null) with run details; returns false when no more runs remain.
requirements: run may be null to only advance without retrieving data.
Each successful call updates run fields that point into the blob’s internal storage; do not modify or free them and ensure the blob outlives their use.

functions.name: SkTextBlob::Iter::experimentalNext
functions.description: Experimental API to advance to the next run, returning font, glyphs, and positions. Marked experimental and subject to change or removal.
requirements: run may be null to only advance without retrieving data.
This API is experimental and should not be relied upon for stable behavior or ABI; use at your own risk.
Pointers returned in run refer to blob-internal storage; ensure the blob outlives their use.

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::SkTextBlobBuilder
functions.description: Constructs an empty builder used to assemble runs into an SkTextBlob.
requirements: Initially contains no runs; allocate runs with alloc* methods before calling make().

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::~SkTextBlobBuilder
functions.description: Destroys the builder and releases any internal storage it owns.
requirements: Do not use the builder after destruction.
Any SkTextBlob produced via make() remains valid independently.

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::make
functions.description: Finalizes and returns an immutable SkTextBlob from the runs added to the builder. Returns nullptr if no runs were added. Resets the builder to an empty state for reuse.
requirements: Caller should not write to previously returned RunBuffer pointers after calling make().
Subsequent allocations will begin a new blob.

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRun
functions.signature: const SkTextBlobBuilder::RunBuffer& SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRun(const SkFont& font, int count, SkScalar x, SkScalar y, const SkRect* bounds)
functions.description: Allocates storage for a run of glyphs positioned by default advances starting at baseline (x, y). Provides writable buffers for glyph indices only; pos/text/cluster are not used for this mode. Optional bounds may accelerate culling.
requirements: Caller must write exactly count glyph IDs into RunBuffer::glyphs before the next builder call.
RunBuffer::pos, RunBuffer::utf8text, and RunBuffer::clusters must be ignored for this run type.
font defines metrics shared by all glyphs in the run.
If bounds is provided, it should tightly bound the run to improve culling; otherwise bounds are derived conservatively from (x, y) and glyph metrics.
Callers must complete writing before invoking any other alloc* or make().

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunPosH
functions.signature: const SkTextBlobBuilder::RunBuffer& SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunPosH(const SkFont& font, int count, SkScalar y, const SkRect* bounds)
functions.description: Allocates storage for a run of glyphs positioned along a baseline at y with explicit x positions. Provides writable glyph buffer and an array of count scalars in RunBuffer::pos representing x positions.
requirements: Caller must write exactly count glyph IDs into RunBuffer::glyphs and exactly count SkScalar x values into RunBuffer::pos before the next builder call.
RunBuffer::utf8text and RunBuffer::clusters must be ignored for this run type.
font defines metrics shared by all glyphs in the run.
If bounds is provided, it should bound the run; otherwise bounds are derived from y, positions, and glyph metrics.
Complete all writes before any subsequent alloc* or make().

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunPos
functions.signature: const SkTextBlobBuilder::RunBuffer& SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunPos(const SkFont& font, int count, const SkRect* bounds)
functions.description: Allocates storage for a run of glyphs with explicit SkPoint positions. Provides writable glyph buffer and an array of count SkPoint values via RunBuffer::points() (backed by RunBuffer::pos).
requirements: Caller must write exactly count glyph IDs into RunBuffer::glyphs and exactly count SkPoint values into RunBuffer::pos (via points()) before the next builder call.
RunBuffer::utf8text and RunBuffer::clusters must be ignored for this run type.
font defines metrics shared by all glyphs in the run.
If bounds is provided, it should bound the run; otherwise bounds are derived from positions and glyph metrics.
Complete all writes before any subsequent alloc* or make().

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunRSXform
functions.signature: const SkTextBlobBuilder::RunBuffer& SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunRSXform(const SkFont& font, int count)
functions.description: Allocates storage for a run of glyphs with per-glyph SkRSXform transforms. RunBuffer::pos points to an array of count SkRSXform values accessible via xforms().
requirements: Caller must write exactly count glyph IDs into RunBuffer::glyphs and exactly count SkRSXform values into RunBuffer::pos (via xforms()) before the next builder call.
font defines metrics shared by all glyphs in the run.
Complete all writes before any subsequent alloc* or make().

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunText
functions.signature: const SkTextBlobBuilder::RunBuffer& SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunText(const SkFont& font, int count, SkScalar x, SkScalar y, int textByteCount, const SkRect* bounds)
functions.description: Allocates storage for a run positioned by default advances from baseline (x, y), plus associated UTF-8 text and cluster indices. Provides writable glyphs, utf8text (textByteCount bytes), and clusters (count indices mapping glyphs to UTF-8 code unit indices).
requirements: Caller must write exactly count glyph IDs into RunBuffer::glyphs before the next builder call.
Caller must write exactly textByteCount bytes of UTF-8 into RunBuffer::utf8text.
Caller must write exactly count monotonically non-decreasing cluster indices into RunBuffer::clusters, each an index into utf8text.
RunBuffer::pos is unused for this run type and must be ignored.
font defines metrics shared by all glyphs in the run.
If bounds is provided, it should bound the run; otherwise bounds are derived from (x, y) and glyph metrics.
All buffers must be fully populated before any subsequent alloc* or make().

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunTextPosH
functions.signature: const SkTextBlobBuilder::RunBuffer& SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunTextPosH(const SkFont& font, int count, SkScalar y, int textByteCount, const SkRect* bounds)
functions.description: Allocates storage for a run positioned along baseline y with explicit x positions, plus associated UTF-8 text and cluster indices. Provides writable glyphs, x positions in RunBuffer::pos (count scalars), utf8text (textByteCount bytes), and clusters (count indices).
requirements: Caller must write exactly count glyph IDs into RunBuffer::glyphs.
Caller must write exactly count SkScalar x positions into RunBuffer::pos.
Caller must write exactly textByteCount bytes of UTF-8 into RunBuffer::utf8text.
Caller must write exactly count monotonically non-decreasing cluster indices into RunBuffer::clusters, referencing positions in utf8text.
font defines metrics shared by all glyphs in the run.
If bounds is provided, it should bound the run; otherwise bounds are derived from y, positions, and glyph metrics.
All buffers must be fully populated before any subsequent alloc* or make().

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunTextPos
functions.signature: const SkTextBlobBuilder::RunBuffer& SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunTextPos(const SkFont& font, int count, int textByteCount, const SkRect* bounds)
functions.description: Allocates storage for a run with explicit SkPoint positions, plus associated UTF-8 text and cluster indices. Provides writable glyphs, positions in RunBuffer::pos (count SkPoint), utf8text (textByteCount bytes), and clusters (count indices).
requirements: Caller must write exactly count glyph IDs into RunBuffer::glyphs.
Caller must write exactly count SkPoint values into RunBuffer::pos (via points()).
Caller must write exactly textByteCount bytes of UTF-8 into RunBuffer::utf8text.
Caller must write exactly count monotonically non-decreasing cluster indices into RunBuffer::clusters, indexing utf8text.
font defines metrics shared by all glyphs in the run.
If bounds is provided, it should bound the run; otherwise bounds are derived from positions and glyph metrics.
All buffers must be fully populated before any subsequent alloc* or make().

functions.name: SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunTextRSXform
functions.signature: const SkTextBlobBuilder::RunBuffer& SkTextBlobBuilder::allocRunTextRSXform(const SkFont& font, int count, int textByteCount, const SkRect* bounds)
functions.description: Allocates storage for a run with per-glyph SkRSXform transforms, plus associated UTF-8 text and cluster indices. RunBuffer::pos points to count SkRSXform values; also provides utf8text and clusters.
requirements: Caller must write exactly count glyph IDs into RunBuffer::glyphs.
Caller must write exactly count SkRSXform values into RunBuffer::pos (via xforms()).
Caller must write exactly textByteCount bytes of UTF-8 into RunBuffer::utf8text.
Caller must write exactly count monotonically non-decreasing cluster indices into RunBuffer::clusters, indexing utf8text.
font defines metrics shared by all glyphs in the run.
If bounds is provided, it should bound the run; otherwise bounds are derived conservatively from transforms and glyph metrics.
All buffers must be fully populated before any subsequent alloc* or make().

functions.name: SkTypeface::fontStyle
functions.description: Returns the typeface’s intrinsic style attributes (weight, width, slant). Used to query how the font intrinsically identifies itself, independent of algorithmic styling.

functions.name: SkTypeface::isBold
functions.description: Returns true if the intrinsic style has the bold bit set.

functions.name: SkTypeface::isItalic
functions.description: Returns true if the intrinsic style has the italic bit set.

functions.name: SkTypeface::isFixedPitch
functions.description: Returns true if the typeface claims to be fixed-pitch. This is only a style bit; advance widths may still vary.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getVariationDesignPosition
functions.description: Copies the current design-variation coordinates into the caller-provided span. Returns the number of axes, or -1 on error. If coordinates.size() >= numAxes, the span is filled with the current position; otherwise only the axis count can be obtained.
requirements: coordinates must point to writable storage of the reported axis count to receive all coordinates; smaller spans return only the axis count.
Return value -1 indicates an error; caller should handle this as failure.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getVariationDesignPosition
functions.description: Legacy unspanned API: copies design‑variation coordinates into the provided array of length count. Returns the number of axes or -1 on error. Behaves like the span-based overload.
requirements: coordinates must point to writable storage with at least count elements.
If count is less than the number of axes, only axis count can be retrieved.
Return value -1 indicates an error.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getVariationDesignParameters
functions.description: Copies the design-variation parameters (axes definitions) into the caller-provided span. Returns the number of axes, or -1 on error. If parameters.size() >= numAxes, the span is filled with axis parameters; otherwise only the axis count can be obtained.
requirements: parameters must point to writable storage of at least the number of axes to receive all axis parameters.
Return value -1 indicates an error; caller should handle this as failure.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getVariationDesignParameters
functions.description: Legacy unspanned API: copies design‑variation axis parameters into the provided array of length count. Returns the number of axes or -1 on error. Behaves like the span-based overload.
requirements: parameters must point to writable storage with at least count elements.
If count is less than the number of axes, only axis count can be retrieved.
Return value -1 indicates an error.

functions.name: SkTypeface::uniqueID
functions.description: Returns a non-zero ID unique to the underlying font data of this typeface instance.

functions.name: SkTypeface::Equal
functions.signature: static bool Equal(const SkTypeface* facea, const SkTypeface* faceb);
functions.description: Compares two typefaces for referencing the same underlying font. Safely handles nulls (null is not equal to any font).

functions.name: SkTypeface::MakeEmpty
functions.description: Creates a non-null typeface that contains no glyphs. Useful as a placeholder or sentinel.

functions.name: SkTypeface::makeClone
functions.description: Creates a new typeface based on this one, applying parameters from SkFontArguments. Unspecified parameters inherit from this typeface. May return nullptr on failure; if the result would be exactly identical, this typeface may be returned instead.
requirements: Caller must handle a nullptr return indicating cloning failed.

functions.name: SkTypeface::serialize
functions.signature: void serialize(SkWStream* dst, SerializeBehavior behavior = SerializeBehavior::kIncludeDataIfLocal) const;
functions.description: Writes a unique signature sufficient to reconstruct an equivalent typeface via MakeDeserialize to the provided stream. The behavior controls whether to include font data.
requirements: dst must be a valid, writable SkWStream pointer.
Caller chooses SerializeBehavior: kDoIncludeData, kDontIncludeData, or kIncludeDataIfLocal.
Caller must manage the lifetime of dst.

functions.name: SkTypeface::MakeDeserialize
functions.signature: static sk_sp<SkTypeface> MakeDeserialize(SkStream* src, sk_sp<SkFontMgr> lastResortMgr);
functions.description: Creates a typeface from data previously written by serialize(). Tries registered typeface factories and optionally lastResortMgr. Returns nullptr if the referenced font is unavailable. Does not take ownership of the input stream.
requirements: src must supply the bytes produced by SkTypeface::serialize().
Caller retains ownership of src; the function does not affect stream ownership.
lastResortMgr may be null.

functions.name: SkTypeface::unicharsToGlyphs
functions.signature: void unicharsToGlyphs(SkSpan<const SkUnichar> unis, SkSpan<SkGlyphID> glyphs) const;
functions.description: Maps an array of UTF-32 code points to corresponding glyph IDs in this typeface. Unsupported characters map to glyph ID 0.
requirements: glyphs span should be at least as large as unis to receive all mappings; otherwise only the first min(sizes) entries are meaningful (inferred from typical Skia conventions).

functions.name: SkTypeface::unicharsToGlyphs
functions.signature: void unicharsToGlyphs(const SkUnichar unis[], int count, SkGlyphID glyphs[]) const;
functions.description: Legacy unspanned API: maps count UTF‑32 code points from unis to glyph IDs written to glyphs. Unsupported characters map to 0. Wraps the span-based overload.
requirements: unis must point to at least count UTF‑32 code points.
glyphs must point to an array of at least count entries to receive all mappings.

functions.name: SkTypeface::textToGlyphs
functions.signature: size_t textToGlyphs(const void* text, size_t byteLength, SkTextEncoding encoding, SkSpan<SkGlyphID> glyphs) const;
functions.description: Converts encoded text to glyph IDs for this typeface. Returns the number of glyphs produced and written to the glyphs span (up to glyphs.size()).
requirements: text points to a buffer of at least byteLength bytes when byteLength > 0.
encoding must be a valid SkTextEncoding for the provided text buffer.
glyphs span capacity limits how many glyphs can be written.

functions.name: SkTypeface::textToGlyphs
functions.signature: int textToGlyphs(const void* text, size_t byteLength, SkTextEncoding encoding, SkGlyphID glyphs[], int maxGlyphCount) const;
functions.description: Legacy unspanned API: converts text buffer to glyph IDs for this typeface, writing up to maxGlyphCount entries into glyphs. Returns the number of glyphs written. Wraps the span-based overload.
requirements: text points to a buffer of at least byteLength bytes when byteLength > 0.
encoding must match the text buffer format.
glyphs must point to storage for at least maxGlyphCount glyph IDs; only that many will be written.

functions.name: SkTypeface::unicharToGlyph
functions.description: Returns the glyph ID for a single UTF-32 code point. Returns 0 if unsupported. Shortcut for unicharsToGlyphs().

functions.name: SkTypeface::countGlyphs
functions.description: Returns the number of glyphs in the typeface.

functions.name: SkTypeface::countTables
functions.description: Returns the number of 4-byte-tag tables in the font, or 0 on error (format may not be table-organized).

functions.name: SkTypeface::readTableTags
functions.description: Copies the list of table tags into the provided span and returns the number of tables. If tags is empty, only returns the count (same as countTables()). Returns 0 on error.
requirements: If tags.size() >= number of tables, the span will be filled with all tags; otherwise only the count is available.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getTableSize
functions.description: Returns the byte size of the table identified by tag, or 0 if not present.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getTableData
functions.signature: size_t getTableData(SkFontTableTag tag, size_t offset, size_t length, void* data) const;
functions.description: Copies up to length bytes from the table identified by tag starting at offset into data. Returns the number of bytes actually copied. If offset+length exceeds the table size, only the available bytes are copied. Returns 0 if the tag is invalid or offset is beyond the table end. Table bytes are in their native endian order.
requirements: data must point to writable storage of at least length bytes; on partial copy fewer bytes may be written.
If tag is not found or offset > table size, 0 is returned and data contents are undefined.
Caller must handle that some or all of data may be written even if an error occurs.

functions.name: SkTypeface::copyTableData
functions.description: Returns an immutable copy of the requested font table’s data, or nullptr if the table is not found. Often faster than querying size then calling getTableData().

functions.name: SkTypeface::getUnitsPerEm
functions.description: Returns the units-per-em value for this typeface, or 0 on error.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getKerningPairAdjustments
functions.signature: bool getKerningPairAdjustments(SkSpan<const SkGlyphID> glyphs, SkSpan<int32_t> adjustments) const;
functions.description: Computes horizontal kerning adjustments (in design units) for the given glyph run. Returns true if kerning should be applied and adjustments were computed for up to min(glyphs.size()-1, adjustments.size()) pairs. If called with empty spans, returns whether the typeface might support kerning. If false is returned, no kerning should be applied and adjustments are undefined.
requirements: If glyphs has N>=1, at most N-1 adjustments are written; adjustments span capacity limits the number written.
If the function returns false, the adjustments span content must be ignored.
Glyph IDs should be valid for this typeface (inferred from purpose).

functions.name: SkTypeface::getKerningPairAdjustments
functions.signature: bool getKerningPairAdjustments(const SkGlyphID glyphs[], int count, int32_t adjustments[]) const;
functions.description: Legacy unspanned API: computes kerning adjustments for a glyph run of length count, writing up to count adjustments into the adjustments array. Returns true if kerning should be applied; false means adjustments are undefined. Wraps the span-based overload.
requirements: glyphs must point to at least count glyph IDs.
adjustments must point to at least count int32_t entries; only up to count-1 meaningful values correspond to adjacent pairs.
If the function returns false, the adjustments array content must be ignored.

functions.name: SkTypeface::createFamilyNameIterator
functions.description: Creates an iterator over all family names specified by the font. Caller is responsible for destroying it using unref().
requirements: Caller must call unref() on the returned LocalizedStrings* when done.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getFamilyName
functions.description: Writes the family name of this typeface into name. Returned as UTF‑8; the language is platform-dependent.
requirements: name must be a valid non-null pointer to an SkString to receive the result.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getPostScriptName
functions.description: Retrieves the PostScript name for this typeface into name. Value may change with variation parameters. Returns false if no PostScript name is available.
requirements: name must be a valid non-null pointer to an SkString to receive the result.
Caller must check the boolean return to see if a value was provided.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getResourceName
functions.description: If the primary resource backing this typeface has a Unicode-representable name (e.g., file path or URL), writes it into resourceName. Returns the number of resources backing this typeface. For local collections the path may or may not exist and may not recreate an identical typeface.
requirements: resourceName may be null if the caller wants only the count; if non-null it will be set when a resource name is available (inferred from wording).
Caller should not assume the path exists or reproduces the same typeface.

functions.name: SkTypeface::openStream
functions.description: Returns a stream for the font data contents, or nullptr on failure. If ttcIndex is non-null, it is set to the TrueType Collection index of this typeface in the stream, or 0 if not a collection. Caller owns the returned stream.
requirements: Caller must manage and delete/let unique_ptr destroy the returned SkStreamAsset.
ttcIndex may be null; if non-null, the function will write the TTC index.

functions.name: SkTypeface::openExistingStream
functions.description: Returns a stream for the font data if the data is already available in stream form; otherwise returns nullptr or failure. Prefer when a stream can be used opportunistically to avoid expensive creation. Acts like openStream when available.
requirements: ttcIndex may be null; if non-null, the function will write the TTC index.
Caller must manage the returned unique_ptr.

functions.name: SkTypeface::createScalerContext
functions.signature: std::unique_ptr<SkScalerContext> createScalerContext(const SkScalerContextEffects& effects, const SkDescriptor* desc) const;
functions.description: Creates a scaler context for this typeface and descriptor. May return a stub context that draws nothing but is safe to use. Used for glyph rasterization/scaling operations.
requirements: effects and desc must describe a valid scaling configuration understood by the backend (details not specified in header).
Caller owns the returned unique_ptr.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getBounds
functions.description: Returns the union of bounds of all glyphs positioned at origin, scaled to 1‑pt. May be conservatively large; does not account for hinting or size-specific adjustments.

functions.name: SkTypeface::Register
functions.signature: static void Register(FactoryId id, sk_sp<SkTypeface> (*make)(std::unique_ptr<SkStreamAsset>, const SkFontArguments&));
functions.description: Registers a factory for creating SkTypefaces from streams and font arguments, identified by a four‑byte tag. Used by deserialization and font managers to construct typefaces.
requirements: make must be a valid function pointer taking ownership of the provided stream and honoring the font arguments (inferred from signature).
id should be a four‑byte tag reserved/managed by the caller; Skia reserves tags beginning with lowercase letter and 0.

functions.name: SkTypeface::getTableTags
functions.description: Legacy unspanned API: fills the provided array with font table tags and returns the number of tables. If tags is nullptr, returns only the count. Internally uses a reasonable maximum capacity.
requirements: tags may be null to query count only; if non-null, it must point to storage sufficient for the implementation’s maximum number of tags (implementation uses an internal cap).

functions.name: SkFontStyle::SkFontStyle
functions.signature: constexpr SkFontStyle::SkFontStyle(int weight, int width, Slant slant)
functions.description: Constructs a font style from weight, width, and slant. Inputs are clamped to valid ranges using SkTPin: weight to [kInvisible_Weight..kExtraBlack_Weight] (0..1000), width to [kUltraCondensed_Width..kUltraExpanded_Width] (1..9), and slant to [kUpright_Slant..kOblique_Slant]. Intended for creating specific font styles when loading or matching typefaces.
requirements: Argument weight is meaningful in the range 0..1000; values outside are clamped to this range.
Argument width is meaningful in the range 1..9; values outside are clamped to this range.
Argument slant must be a valid SkFontStyle::Slant enumerator; integer values outside the enum range are clamped to a valid enumerator.
No dynamic allocation or side effects; usable in constant expressions due to constexpr.

functions.name: SkFontStyle::operator==
functions.description: Compares two SkFontStyle instances for exact equality of their encoded style value (weight, width, slant). Use to test if two styles are identical.
requirements: Both objects must be valid SkFontStyle instances.
Performs value equality; no ordering or tolerance.

functions.name: SkFontStyle::weight
functions.description: Returns the numeric font weight component of the style (0..1000).
requirements: Callable on any valid SkFontStyle instance.
Return value is an integer in the range 0..1000.

functions.name: SkFontStyle::width
functions.description: Returns the numeric font width (stretch) component of the style using SkFontStyle::Width values (1..9).
requirements: Callable on any valid SkFontStyle instance.
Return value is an integer in the range 1..9 corresponding to Width enum values.

functions.name: SkFontStyle::slant
functions.description: Returns the slant component of the style (Upright, Italic, or Oblique).
requirements: Callable on any valid SkFontStyle instance.
Return value is one of SkFontStyle::Slant enumerators.

functions.name: SkFontStyle::Normal
functions.description: Factory for the normal, upright style (weight 400, width 5, slant Upright).
requirements: No arguments; usable in constant expressions due to constexpr.
Returns a valid SkFontStyle configured as normal upright.

functions.name: SkFontStyle::Bold
functions.description: Factory for the bold, upright style (weight 700, width 5, slant Upright).
requirements: No arguments; usable in constant expressions due to constexpr.
Returns a valid SkFontStyle configured as bold upright.

functions.name: SkFontStyle::Italic
functions.description: Factory for the normal-weight italic style (weight 400, width 5, slant Italic).
requirements: No arguments; usable in constant expressions due to constexpr.
Returns a valid SkFontStyle configured as normal italic.

functions.name: SkFontStyle::BoldItalic
functions.description: Factory for the bold italic style (weight 700, width 5, slant Italic).
requirements: No arguments; usable in constant expressions due to constexpr.
Returns a valid SkFontStyle configured as bold italic.

functions.name: SkFont::SkFont
functions.description: Default constructor creating a SkFont with default typeface and default font parameters (size, scale, skew, flags, edging, hinting). Use when you want a baseline font configuration and then customize with setters.
requirements: None beyond having a valid Skia runtime; constructs an object in a default-initialized state.

functions.name: SkFont::SkFont
functions.description: Constructs a SkFont using the provided typeface and EM size in local coordinates. Other settings use defaults.
